name: Josefa in Gilberto's 1895 household (b. c.1852)
source: Argentina, National Census 1895, Ciudad de la Capital, Seccion 21, Manzana 15 - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:S3HT-DZTW-9S9; and named as godmother at the Catedral de Montevideo, 10 Sep 1885, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-BQZD-W
note: *** ALMOST CERTAINLY THE JOSEFA LERENA WHO STOOD GODMOTHER TO GILBERTO'S SON RAUL at the Catedral de Montevideo on 10 September 1885 *** - a woman this archive met and could not place. The 1895 census finds her in Gilberto's own Buenos Aires household: "Lerena de L. Josefa, m, 43, VIUDA, R. Oriental". Born about 1852, so of his generation. *** THE FORM OF HER NAME IS 'LERENA DE L.' *** On the two lines above her the enumerator writes married women as [maiden surname] de L. - Lenguas de Lerena, Salvanach de Lerena. If he is consistent, SHE WAS BORN A LERENA AND MARRIED A LERENA. *** That is the exact pattern behind this archive's standing question - whether Maria Lerena, named on Pablo Armando's enrolment card, was a Lerena by birth. *** Stated as a reading of an abbreviation in an enumerator's hand, not as a fact: her own marriage record would settle it and has not been looked for. *** CORRECTED WITHIN THE HOUR: THE 'DE LERENA' READING IS WITHDRAWN AS EVIDENCE. *** Uruguayan civil registration carries a JOSEFA LERENA married to FERNANDO MORATORIO, and FamilySearch's tree attaches her to Josefa Lerena Traibel 1851-1947 - the same candidate. If that is this woman, "de L." is the enumerator's shorthand for the LERENA HOUSEHOLD rather than her husband's surname, and this entry says nothing about a Lerena-Lerena marriage. The letter was read right; the inference was not. See data/josefa-lerena-candidates.tsv. *** AND THE WITHDRAWAL IS NOW ON A DOCUMENT RATHER THAN A TREE. *** The 1880 baptisms of Josefa Lerena's daughters name her husband Fernando Moratorio and her parents Avelino and Ambrosia Traibel. If this census woman is that Josefa - she is 43 here against a birth of 1851, and a VIUDA where a later record calls Fernando Moratorio "fallecido" - then "de L." is the enumerator's shorthand for the LERENA HOUSEHOLD and nothing more.

name: Josefa LERENA TRAIBEL (1851-1947)
source: Montevideo civil death registration No. 10, 3 April 1947 - index read; ark 1:1:617P-WJY6, image 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-DPLX; and the baptisms of her two daughters, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 8 Mar 1880 (this archive placed it at the UNION until 21 Sep 2026, on the index's place field; the act says 'esta Basilica menor y Catedral'), ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J; and her own baptism at San Agustin de la Union, 1852, read in the 1896 certified copy - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02850
note: *** DAUGHTER OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL - which places the LERENA TRAIBEL branch this archive has named since its first week. *** Died 2 April 1947 at Montevideo, aged NINETY-SIX. *** A STRONG CANDIDATE for the Josefa Lerena who stood godmother at the Catedral in 1885 and for the "Lerena de L. Josefa, 43, viuda" in Gilberto's 1895 Buenos Aires household - the ages agree within a year. DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED WITH THEM: *** this archive conflated two Arturo Lerenas in the same week and had to retract a branch within the hour. See data/josefa-lerena-candidates.tsv for what fits and what is untested. *** AND SHE MARRIED A MORATORIO, NOT A LERENA - NOW ON A PARISH ACT. *** Uruguayan civil registration names a Josefa Lerena as mother of Josefa, Eduardo and Maria MORATORIO LERENA, "Spouses: Fernando Moratorio", and the FamilySearch tree attaches that woman to this one. The marriage records are index-level and real; the link between the two women is a TREE ATTACHMENT and therefore SECONDARY. *** THE TREE ATTACHMENT IS NO LONGER NEEDED: *** the baptisms of her daughters MARIA CARLOTA and MARIA DE LAS MERCEDES MORATORIO LERENA at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 8 March 1880 name the parents "Fernando Moratorio y Josefa Lerena" and the maternal grandparents "AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL". So the Moratorio wife and the daughter of Avelino are one woman, on a document. *** AND HER CLAIM ON THE 1895 WIDOW IS WEAKER THAN THIS ROW MAKES IT SOUND, 20 September 2026. *** The enumerator writes wives as [maiden surname] "de L.", so his "Lerena de L." married a LERENA - and this woman married a MORATORIO, which the sentence above establishes from a parish act. Either the reading of the abbreviation is wrong, or the 1895 widow is somebody else. The two candidacies this row claims - the 1885 godmother and the 1895 widow - are not equally strong, and nothing here had said so.  *** SHE HAS A BIRTH DAY, 21 September 2026: 10 FEBRUARY 1851. *** Her own baptismal act was found and read: 'bautice solemnemente a una nina a quien puse por nombre JOSEFINA LERENA, que nacio el DIEZ DE FEBRERO DEL ANO PROXIMO PASADO, hija legitima de Avelino Lerena y Ambrosia Traibel'. The act is of 1852; the archive had her year from her 1947 death registration, which is age-derived, and now has the day from the record of her christening. Godparents Don Miguel Carlos Correa de Lemus and Josefa Corbelle de Lemus; priest Domingo Ereno. *** AND HER NAME AT THE FONT IS JOSEFINA, NOT JOSEFA *** - which matters to every search that has been run on her. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND HER BAPTISM HAS A DAY TOO, within the hour: 5 DECEMBER 1852. *** The opening of her act sits on the previous image, 02849, where the archive had not looked: 'Jose Heimen, Cura Vicario de esta Parroquia de San Agustin en la Villa de la Union, certifica: que en el LIBRO PRIMERO DE BAUTISMOS AL FOLIO 212 se halla una partida del tenor siguiente: En cinco de Diciembre de mil...' - and the sentence finishes 'ochocientos cincuenta y dos' at the top of image 02850. *** So she was born 10 February 1851 and baptised at twenty-two months. *** Her certificate is No. 148 of seven the family lodged together in November 1896.

name: Avelino LERENA Fernandez (son of Sancho)
source: Named as father in the Montevideo death registration of Josefa Lerena Traibel, 3 April 1947 - ark 1:1:617P-WJY6; and as maternal grandfather in two Catedral Basilica baptisms of 8 Mar 1880 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J; and as father of the groom in the Catedral marriage of 3 Feb 1892 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K; and TWO baptisms of his children, San Francisco de Asis, 12 Mar 1858, naming his parents - San Francisco de Asis, Montevideo, baptisms of 12 Mar 1858 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4; and his own MONTEVIDEO CIVIL DEATH REGISTRATION of 23 Aug 1890 - index read, ark 1:1:62J2-4CNQ, image 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-K796-D NOT YET OPENED; and the baptism of his son ALEJANDRO at La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, 7 Jan 1846 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS62-J; and the 1852 Aguada baptism of his son Pedro Alberto Ysabelino - IMAGE READ, film 008166435 image 02850
note: *** THE HEAD OF THE LERENA TRAIBEL BRANCH, named at last on 14 September 2026. *** Husband of AMBROSIA TRAIBEL and father of Josefa Lerena Traibel, born 1851. This archive has referred to the Lerena Traibel since its first week without ever placing Avelino. *** HE IS SANCHO'S SON - SETTLED 14 September 2026 ON A PARISH ACT. *** An Avelino Lerena stood godfather at the Catedral de Montevideo in 1833 to a child of Justa Pastora Lerena, Sancho's daughter, which is suggestive and no more. No record found here names Avelino's own parents. *** AND HE IS NAMED IN A PARISH ACT, not only in a death index: *** the baptisms of his granddaughters at Union on 8 March 1880 give "abuelos maternos AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL". *** A SECOND CHILD FOUND, 14 September 2026: ALFREDO, born about 1857, married at the Catedral Basilica on 3 February 1892 *** - "hijo legitimo de Don AVELINO LORENA y Dona Ambrosia Traibel". So Avelino and Ambrosia had at least JOSEFA (1851) and ALFREDO (c.1857), and probably MERCEDES, who stood godmother in 1880. *** TWO BAPTISMS OF 12 MARCH 1858 AT SAN FRANCISCO DE ASIS name the paternal grandparents of his children as SANCHO LERENA and MARIA FERNANDEZ - twice, on one page. *** So the whole LERENA TRAIBEL line descends from Sancho, and several of its members were already floating unattached in this register: Mercedes Micaela and Clorinda in the dispensation table, and JUAN ARTURO - the man this archive conflated with another Arturo in its first week and had to retract. *** And the godparents at those two fonts were LAVALLEJA - Justiniano, Constantino and Ana. *** *** AND HE NOW HAS DATES, 14 September 2026: BORN 1815, DIED 22 AUGUST 1890 at Montevideo, registered the next day. *** The registration names his parents Sancho and Maria Fernandez - an INDEPENDENT attestation of the parentage the 1858 baptisms settled, and the first record in this archive to say when Avelino lived. *** IT ALSO EXPLAINS SOMETHING THE ARCHIVE HAD ONLY NOTED AS ODD. *** At his son Alfredo's wedding in February 1892 the witness was AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, the mother, where a father would be expected. Avelino had been dead sixteen months. Three records - the 1858 fonts, this registration, and the 1892 marriage - now lock together in one order. The registration spells him LEVENA, an eighth spelling. The image has not been opened, so the dates are SECONDARY; the parentage is PRIMARY from 1858. *** AND AN ELDEST CHILD, found 14 September 2026 - by correcting one of this archive's own rows. *** ALEJANDRO, born 29 May 1843, baptised at La Mauricia on 7 January 1846, "hijo legitimo de Avelino Serena y Ambrosia Traibel" - a boy this archive had wrongly recorded as a sixth child of his brother Luis. So Avelino and Ambrosia were married before May 1843, and their known children run ALEJANDRO (1843), JOSEFA (1851), ALFREDO JUSTINIANO and ANA ROSARIO (1858), probably MERCEDES. *** And the act shows the two brothers standing as godparents for each other's children at the same font on the same morning *** - Luis and Justiniana for Alejandro, while Luis's own two were christened in the entries just above. *** AND HE DID NOT MARRY TWICE - DECIDED 20 September 2026. *** The LERENA VILLADEMOROS branch found on 16 September was left as two readings: a second marriage of his, or a son of his. *** It is a son. *** Two parish acts give AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA's own father as Avelino with Ambrosia Traibel on the record, so Avelino Eduardo joins Alejandro, Josefa, Ana Rosario, Alfredo Justiniano and Mercedes as a child of this marriage, and Celedonia Villademoros is a daughter-in-law.  *** NINE CHILDREN, 21 September 2026, where this row listed six. *** A parent-pair search on Avelino with Ambrosia added four: *** PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO (b. 16 March 1852, and he is the ALBERTO who died in 1921) ***, *** JUAN ARTURO (b. 16 February 1861) ***, *** MERCEDES MICAELA (b. 8 May 1863) *** - who is very likely the Mercedes who stood godmother in 1880 - and *** MARIA ADELINA ***, who married Carlos Alberto Fein and died in 1946. With Alejandro, Josefa, Ana Rosario, Alfredo Justiniano and Avelino Eduardo that is nine, and the births run from 1843 to about 1865 - twenty-two years, which is one marriage and not two. *** A THIRD INDEPENDENT ACT NAMES HIS PARENTS: *** the 1852 Aguada baptism gives the paternal grandparents as Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez, after the two of 1858 and the christening of 1866. *** AND THE 1852 ACTS CALL HIM AN ORIENTAL: *** 'orientales los padres' at the Aguada, which agrees with a birth at Montevideo in 1815. The same page then calls SANCHO oriental too, and that one this archive does not accept - see the working log.  *** TEN, WITHIN THE HOUR. *** ANDRES, born 16 March 1857, was read off the second opening of the same certificate book. *** And his sons appear as godfathers to his daughters: *** Avelino Eduardo stood for Andres in 1861, written 'AVELINO LERENA (HIJO)', and an AMBROSIO LERENA - almost certainly the Carlos Ambrosio of the family chart - stood for Maria Adelina in 1865. *** The births now run 1843, 1851, 1852, 1855, 1856, 1857, 1861, 1863, 1865 with Avelino Eduardo earlier still ***, which is a single marriage producing a child about every two years for twenty-two years.  *** SEVEN OF HIS CHILDREN LODGED BAPTISMAL CERTIFICATES TOGETHER IN NOVEMBER 1896, and this archive thinks it knows why. *** Certificates 147 to 153 of one Montevideo book, consecutive, drawn from FOUR different parishes - the Aguada, San Agustin de la Union, San Francisco de Asis and the Cordon - and registered within days of each other: Mercedes Micaela, Josefina, Pedro Alberto Ysabelino, Ana Rosario, Juan Arturo, Andres and Maria Adelina. *** Grown brothers and sisters do not each happen to want proof of baptism in the same week. That is what proving FILIATION looks like, and their father had died on 22 August 1890. *** Offered as a hypothesis with a named test: the Montevideo succession and notarial records of 1896. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND THE PARISH WAS WRONG, CORRECTED 21 September 2026 OFF THE PLATE. *** This archive placed these 1880 baptisms at the *** UNION ***, which is what the index's place field says. The act itself reads *** 'con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco DE ESTA BASILICA MENOR Y CATEDRAL DE MONTEVIDEO, bautice solemnemente EN ELLA a Maria Carlota' ***. *** They were baptised in the CATEDRAL BASILICA, not at the Union. ***

name: Ambrosia TRAIBEL
source: Named as mother in the Montevideo death registration of Josefa Lerena Traibel, 3 April 1947 - ark 1:1:617P-WJY6; and as a witness at her son Alfredo's marriage, 3 Feb 1892 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K
note: Wife of Avelino Lerena and mother of Josefa Lerena Traibel (1851-1947). She is the TRAIBEL of the Lerena Traibel branch. *** SHE WAS ALIVE IN FEBRUARY 1892 AND STOOD WITNESS AT HER SON'S WEDDING: *** "fueron testigos Don Carlos Navia y Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL" - which is unusual enough to be worth noting; a mother as formal witness rather than a male relative. *** HER OWN PARENTS ARE NAMED: JUAN TRAIBEL and YSABEL CENTENO *** - from the two baptisms of 12 March 1858. A POLONIA TRAIBEL stood godmother at one of them, presumably her sister. *** HER PARENTS ARE NOW ATTESTED TWELVE YEARS EARLIER THAN THE 1858 ACTS. *** The baptism of her son Alejandro on 7 January 1846 gives the maternal grandparents as "JUAN e ISABEL CENTENO" - the same pair the 1858 baptisms name as Juan Traibel and Ysabel Centeno. Two independent acts, twelve years apart, agreeing. *** And she was a married woman by 1843. ***

name: Andres LERENA Traibel
source: Nuestra Senora del Carmen, el Cordon, Montevideo - libro 7o de Bautismos, read in the 1896 certified copy made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02852 pagina 378; index ark 1:1:6DX1-HVKC
note: *** A TENTH CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, dated 21 September 2026 from the act itself. *** FamilySearch indexes him as 'born 16 March 1896, christened 25 November 1896', which is six years after his father died. The act reads: 'En treinta y uno de Diciembre de mil ochocientos sesenta y uno. El Canonigo Dn. JUAN JOSE BRID, bautizo solemnemente a ANDRES, NACIDO EL DIEZ Y SEIS DE MARZO DE MIL OCHOCIENTOS CINCUENTA Y SIETE, hijo legitimo de Dn. Avelino Lerena y de Da. Ambrosia Traibel, ORIENTALES. Padrinos Dn. AVELINO LERENA (HIJO).' *** Born 16 MARCH 1857 and baptised at four years old, on the last day of 1861 *** - the same day his brother Juan Arturo was christened at the same parish, aged ten months. *** HIS GODFATHER IS HIS ELDEST BROTHER, and the parish wrote the disambiguation this archive spent two days arriving at: *** 'AVELINO LERENA (HIJO)' - Avelino the son, which is Avelino Eduardo, and not his father of the same name. *** AND HE SHARES A BIRTHDAY WITH A BROTHER: *** Pedro Alberto Ysabelino was born 16 March 1852, five years to the day before him. That coincidence is what made the index's duplicated '16 March 1896' look like machine noise, and it is not - the index keeps the day and the month and replaces only the year.  *** AND THE YEAR IN THAT ACT CANNOT STAND. THE BIRTH COLUMN IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY, 21 September 2026. *** The archive's own contradiction gate refused the build the moment this row was written, and it was right: *** ALFREDO JUSTINIANO WAS BORN 2 OCTOBER 1856 AND ANDRES IS HERE SAID TO BE BORN 16 MARCH 1857 - five and a half months later, to the same mother. *** Both cannot be true. *** THE WORDS WERE RE-READ AT DOUBLE MAGNIFICATION BEFORE ANYTHING WAS CONCLUDED *** and they are not ambiguous: 'mil ochocientos CINCUENTA Y SIETE'. So the fault is not in the reading. *** THE WEAKER WITNESS IS THIS ONE, AND THE REASON IS THAT IT IS A COPY. *** Andres's year survives only in an 1896 transcript of an 1861 act - two hands between the font and the page read here. Alfredo's comes from the ORIGINAL register of San Francisco de Asis, and it is corroborated independently: a man born 2 October 1856 is thirty-five on 3 February 1892, which is the age he gave the priest at his own wedding. *** WHAT IS KEPT: the day and the month, 16 MARCH, and the baptism of 31 December 1861. WHAT IS NOT: the year. *** He is somewhere between 1857 and 1861 and this archive does not know where. *** THE TEST, and it is a specific one: *** the ORIGINAL entry, libro 7o de Bautismos of Nuestra Senora del Carmen del Cordon, pagina 378 - not the 1896 certificate of it.

name: Maria Ines LARRIERA
source: Named as the wife in the Montevideo death registration of Alberto Lerena, 2 March 1921 - index read; ark 1:1:6LD5-X4PR; her husband's death act READ OFF THE IMAGE 21 September 2026 - film 008165205 image 01604, which is where the words quoted in the note below come from; and Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion y San Felipe y Santiago, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo - BAPTISM RECORDS 13 Feb 1879 to 24 Jul 1880, the christening of 13 October 1879 - *** FULL-TEXT NAMES PANEL READ 11 October 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS34-N
note: Wife of Alberto Lerena (Pedro Alberto Ysabelino, 1852-1921), named at his death. Nothing else in this archive names her.  *** 'NOTHING ELSE IN THIS ARCHIVE NAMES HER' LASTED THREE HOURS. *** Eight children born in the Departamento de San Jose between 1879 and 1898 name her as their mother, and one of them - ZELMIRA CARLOTA - has been in this register since 14 September with her name on it, unrecognised. A *** VICTORIA CROSADE LARRIERA *** stood godmother at her son Carlos Ambrosio Florencio's baptism in 1889, presumably a sister.  *** HER HUSBAND'S DEATH ACT WAS READ OFF THE IMAGE THE SAME DAY: 'era casado con MARIA INES LARRIERA, de cuya union quedan NUEVE HIJOS'. *** She outlived him - the act does not call her fallecida where it calls both his parents so - and she had borne nine children, one more than the civil index surfaces. *** HER OWN PARENTS, AT LAST - 11 October 2026. *** The christening of her eldest, Maria Adelina, at the Montevideo cathedral on 13 October 1879 names the maternal grandparents *** MIGUEL LARRIERA *** and *** CAROLINA CHAVARRIA ***. *** THIS ROW HAS SAID 'NOTHING ELSE IN THIS ARCHIVE NAMES HER' AND THEN BEEN CORRECTED TWICE *** - first by eight children, now by two parents. *** AND IT EXPLAINS A FORENAME: *** her youngest son was ANGEL *** MIGUEL *** AVELINO - Miguel for her father, Avelino for her husband's.

name: Eleiza (or Eloiza) LERENA LARRIERA
source: Named as a daughter in the Montevideo death registration of her father Alberto Lerena, act No. 246 of 2 March 1921 - IMAGE READ; film 008165205 image 01604; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-26FM
note: *** THE NINTH CHILD, AND SHE EXISTS ONLY BECAUSE THE IMAGE WAS OPENED. *** The civil index surfaces eight children of Alberto Lerena and Maria Ines Larriera. Their father's death act counts *** NUEVE HIJOS *** and names them, and the third name on the list belongs to nobody the index has found: *** it reads ELEIZA or ELOIZA and this archive cannot choose between them. *** Read at three times magnification before being written down. *** A SEARCH FOR HER UNDER ELOISA WAS RUN AND PROVED NOTHING: *** the query returned a count with rows that ignore the forename, which is the FamilySearch personas behaviour this archive has documented elsewhere and refuses to draw a null from. *** THE TEST: *** the Uruguayan civil birth registrations of the Departamento de San Jose between 1879 and 1898, read for a daughter of this couple who is not one of the eight - most likely in the gap between Zelmira Carlota, 4 November 1880, and Alberto Julian, 17 August 1883.

name: Maria Adelina LERENA LARRIERA
source: Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020, Departamento San Jose - index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:VR41-7VM; and her christening of 13 Oct 1879, ark 1:1:6D3Z-QYK9; and Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion y San Felipe y Santiago, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo - BAPTISM RECORDS 13 Feb 1879 to 24 Jul 1880, the christening of 13 October 1879 - *** FULL-TEXT NAMES PANEL READ 11 October 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS34-N
note: Eldest known child of Alberto Lerena and Maria Ines Larriera, born in the Departamento de San Jose on 6 July 1879 and christened that October. *** SHE IS NAMED FOR HER AUNT MARIA ADELINA LERENA TRAIBEL ***, born at Montevideo in August 1865 - fourteen years older, and alive when this child was named. A great-granddaughter of Sancho. *** INDEX-LEVEL. *** *** NO LONGER INDEX-LEVEL, AND THE CHRISTENING WAS IN THE CAPITAL - 11 October 2026. *** The act of 13 October 1879 is at the *** CATEDRAL DE LA INMACULADA CONCEPCION, CIUDAD VIEJA, MONTEVIDEO ***, though she was born in the Departamento de San Jose three months earlier. *** AND IT NAMES ALL FOUR GRANDPARENTS, which is what this row needed: *** paternal *** AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***, maternal *** MIGUEL LARRIERA and CAROLINA CHAVARRIA ***. The maternal pair were unknown to this archive until today. *** THE GODPARENTS ARE 'AVELINO LERENA Y ADELINA LERENA' *** - her own grandfather, and an Adelina. *** SO THIS ROW'S GUESS ABOUT HER NAME IS NOW SUPPORTED, THOUGH STILL NOT PROVED: *** it has always said she was named for her aunt MARIA ADELINA LERENA TRAIBEL, and an Adelina Lerena did stand at the font - but the act gives the godmother no second surname, so which Adelina is not settled. *** THE TRANSCRIBER SPELLS THIS FAMILY FOUR WAYS IN ONE ACT: *** 'Alberto LEREÑA' for the father, 'Avelino SERENA' for the grandfather, 'Avelino LEVENA' for the godfather and 'Adelina SERENA' for the godmother. One page, one family, four spellings - which is the ordinary condition of this surname and the reason this archive searches by shape rather than by letter.

name: Angel Miguel Avelino LERENA LARRIERA
source: Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020, Departamento San Jose - index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:VR41-RW6; and his christening of 16 June 1899, ark 1:1:6D34-WHXT; and Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion y San Felipe y Santiago, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo - BAPTISM RECORDS 13 Feb 1879 to 24 Jul 1880, the christening of 13 October 1879 - *** FULL-TEXT NAMES PANEL READ 11 October 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS34-N
note: Youngest known child of Alberto Lerena and Maria Ines Larriera, born 15 August 1898. *** THE AVELINO IS HIS GREAT-GRANDFATHER'S NAME *** - Avelino Lerena Fernandez, dead eight years when this child was born, and the man whose parentage attaches this whole branch to Sancho. *** INDEX-LEVEL. *** *** THIS ROW SAID GREAT-GRANDFATHER AND IT IS WRONG BY A GENERATION - corrected 11 October 2026. *** AVELINO LERENA FERNANDEZ IS HIS GRANDFATHER: this child's father is Pedro Alberto Ysabelino Lerena Traibel, and Avelino is that man's father. One step, not two; data/relations.tsv had the edges right while the prose did not. *** AND THE WHOLE NAME IS NOW READABLE, which is why the slip surfaced. *** His sister's christening of 1879 names the maternal grandfather *** MIGUEL LARRIERA ***. So ANGEL *** MIGUEL AVELINO *** carries *** BOTH OF HIS GRANDFATHERS *** - his mother's father and his father's father - and is not an echo of a distant ancestor at all. *** A NAMING PATTERN IS EVIDENCE ONLY WHEN YOU KNOW BOTH SIDES OF IT. ***

name: Maria Adelina LERENA Traibel (de FEIN)
source: Nuestra Senora del Carmen, el Cordon, Montevideo - libro 7o de Bautismos, read in the 1896 certified copy made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02852 pagina 379; and Montevideo civil death registration No. 48, 20 November 1946 - index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:XS6K-QJ6F
note: *** THE NINTH CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, found 21 September 2026. *** Her Montevideo death registration of 20 November 1946, certificate 48, names her father AVELINO LERENA and her mother AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, her husband *** CARLOS ALBERTO FEIN *** and a son *** JORGE FEIN ***. *** THE BIRTH YEAR IN THIS COLUMN IS NOT A FINDING. *** The registration gives her birth as 1861 and her birthplace as Montevideo; the family chart gives 1865-1946. *** THE 1861 CANNOT EASILY BE RIGHT, and what rules it out is her own brother. *** Juan Arturo was born 16 February 1861 on his baptismal act, so a sister born in 1861 would have to have been born in the last six weeks of it. The year on a death registration is age-derived and is the weaker of the two, so c.1865 is entered and flagged. *** WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: *** her own baptism, which has not been looked for.  *** THE BIRTH YEAR IS NO LONGER A GUESS, 21 September 2026: SHE WAS BORN 13 AUGUST 1865. *** Her own baptismal act was found on the second opening of the same certificate book and read: 'En treinta y uno de Diciembre de mil ochocientos sesenta y cinco. El Canonigo Dn. Juan Jose Brid, bautizo solemnemente a MARIA ADELINA, NACIDA EL TRECE DE AGOSTO ULTIMO, hija legitima de Dn. Avelino Lerena y de Da. Ambrosia Traibel, Orientales. Padrinos Dn. AMBROSIO LERENA y Da. CARLOTA MUNOZ.' *** So the 1861 on her death registration is wrong by four years, and the reasoning that flagged it was right for the right reason *** - her brother Juan Arturo was born in February 1861 and no sister could be. *** AND A SECOND RECORD OF HER IS THE SAME ACT. *** FamilySearch also indexes a 'MARTA ADELINA, born 13 August 1918, christened Montevideo 9 May 1919', with godparents Ambrosio Lorena and Carlota Munoz - the same two names and the same 13 August. It is this baptism certified a second time, on a different film, and dated by the index to that certificate. *** One act, two films, and two index entries fifty-three years apart. *** *** SHE WAS A WIDOW FROM 17 OR 18 MAY 1919, ***  twenty-seven years before her own death: the Cordon's burial book enters her husband Carlos Alberto Fein, 'casado con Adelina Lerena', on 18 May 1919 (image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-4SHT-C).

name: Mercedes Micaela LERENA Traibel
source: Union, Montevideo - baptism read in the 1896 certified copy No. 147, made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02849; and Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening, Union, Montevideo, 25 September 1866; index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:6D7Z-KHLR
note: *** BORN 8 MAY 1863, christened at the Union on 25 September 1866 *** - daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel, with the paternal grandparents given as *** SANCHO and MARIA FERNANDEZ *** and the maternal as 'Dos Juan' - the machine's reading of DON JUAN Traibel - and Ysabel Centeno. Her godparents were ADOLFO DE LAPUENTE and *** MERCEDES MENDEZ DE LA FUENTE, for whom she is named ***, which is this family's habit four times over. *** SHE IS THE BEST CANDIDATE FOR THE MERCEDES LERENA WHO STOOD GODMOTHER AT THE UNION IN MARCH 1880 *** to her sister Josefa's daughter - who was in turn named Maria de las Mercedes for her. She was sixteen then, which is young and not impossible; the rows are kept apart until an act joins them. The dispensation table here records a *** MERCEDES LERENA who married DON LUIS P. MARQUEZ at the Catedral on 9 July 1883 ***, identified there as this woman - and an unmarried Mercedes Lerena in 1880 is what that marriage date requires. *** INDEX-LEVEL: the image of her christening has not been opened. ***  *** NO LONGER INDEX-LEVEL, 21 September 2026 - THE ACT ITSELF WAS FOUND AND READ. *** Her certificate is No. 147 in the same 1896 book that holds six of her brothers and sisters: 'ella a MERCEDES MICAELA, QUE NACIO EL OCHO DE MAYO DEL ANO MIL OCHOCIENTOS SESENTA Y TRES, hija legitima de Dn. Avelino Lerena y Da. Ambrosia Traibel, orientales. Abuelos paternos Dn. SANCHO y Da. MARIA FERNANDEZ; abuelos maternos Dn. JUAN y Da. YSABEL CENTENO. Padrinos Dn. ADOLFO DE LAPUENTE y Da. MERCEDES MENDEZ DE LA FUENTE, a quienes advirtio. Por verdad lo firmo. INOCENCIO M. YEREQUI.' *** The index had the date right and the archive can now say why it believes it. *** And 'Dos Juan' in the index is settled: the act reads 'Dn. Juan'.

name: Juan Arturo LERENA Traibel
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening, Cordon, Montevideo, 31 December 1861; index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:6D3Z-X999
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, AND HE NOW HAS A BIRTH DATE: 16 FEBRUARY 1861. *** Christened at the Cordon on 31 December 1861. This archive has known the name since its first week and for the worst reason - *** it conflated him with the ARTURO LERENA of army drawer Cajon 985, who married Amalia Diaz, and had to retract. *** He is not that man. The family chart gives him 1861-1936 and a marriage to ISIDORA EMMA REGULES; the dates here come from the parish index, the marriage does not, and neither image has been opened. *** INDEX-LEVEL. ***  *** HE WAS NOT CHRISTENED ALONE, 21 September 2026. *** His brother ANDRES, born 16 March 1857, was baptised at the same parish on the same 31 December 1861, by the same Canonigo JUAN JOSE BRID - whose name stands in the index of this record too, as 'Juan J. Brid'. Juan Arturo was ten months old that day and Andres was four. *** The certificate of Andres's act is on film 008166435 image 02852, libro 7o de Bautismos pagina 378, so Juan Arturo's own act is a page or two away on the same book and has not been pulled. ***

name: Pedro Alberto Ysabelino LERENA Traibel (the ALBERTO of 1852-1921)
source: Vice Parroquia de Nuestra Senora del Carmen, la Aguada, Montevideo - baptism of 21 Nov 1852, libro 1o de Bautismos folio 135, read in the CERTIFIED COPY issued in 1896 - IMAGE READ at full resolution 21 Sep 2026; film 008166435 image 02850, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-2SSK-G; index ark 1:1:6DXB-SSGW; and Montevideo civil death registration No. 246, 1 March 1921 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 008165205 image 01604, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-26FM, index ark 1:1:6LD5-X4PR
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL THIS ARCHIVE HAD SEEN AND NEVER DATED, 21 September 2026. *** The 14 September working log already listed 'Pedro Alberto Isabelino' among the Lerena Traibel, off the index, and left him there. *** THE INDEX SAYS HE WAS BORN IN 1896, WHICH IS SIX YEARS AFTER HIS FATHER DIED. *** The act itself says otherwise: 'El veinte y uno de Noviembre de 1852 ... bautice solemnemente a PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO, que nacio el diez y seis de Marzo del mismo ano, a las once y media del dia, hijo legitimo de AVELINO LERENA y de AMBROSIA TRAIBEL'. *** He was born 16 MARCH 1852 and baptised at eight months. *** What the index dated 1896 is the CERTIFIED COPY, issued that year from libro 1o de Bautismos folio 135. *** HIS GODFATHER WAS HIS UNCLE: PEDRO ANT.o LERENA, with VICENTA VEGA *** - and the boy is named for him, as YSABELINO is for his grandmother Ysabel Centeno. Grandparents on the act: Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez, Juan Traibel and Ysabel Centeno. *** AND HE IS THE ALBERTO LERENA OF THE 1921 DEATH REGISTRATION *** - Montevideo, died 1 March 1921, certificate 246, father Avelino Lerena, mother Ambrosia Treibel, wife MARIA INES LARRIERA. That registration gives his age as 69 against a birth of 16 March 1852, which makes him 68 by three weeks; an age at death is the weakest field on any certificate and the identification does not rest on it. *** THE IDENTIFICATION IS AN INFERENCE, NOT AN ACT: *** no record read here writes 'Pedro Alberto Ysabelino' and 'Alberto' on the same page. What joins them is the parents, the year and the name. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND HE HAD EIGHT CHILDREN, IN A DEPARTMENT THIS BRANCH WAS NEVER KNOWN TO REACH - found 21 September 2026 by asking for him and his wife as a PAIR. *** Alberto Lerena with Maria Ines Larriera returns sixteen Uruguayan records, and they are eight children born in the *** DEPARTAMENTO DE SAN JOSE *** between 1879 and 1898: MARIA ADELINA (1879), ZELMIRA CARLOTA (1880), ALBERTO JULIAN (1883), CARLOS AMBROSIO FLORENCIO (bapt. 1889), MARIA CONSUELO (1892), MARIA ANTONIETA (1894), ANGEL MIGUEL AVELINO (1898) and MARIA INES, who died at Montevideo in 1922. *** ZELMIRA WAS ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER, entered on 14 September and written off as 'NOT ours'. *** She is his daughter. *** THREE OF THE EIGHT CARRY NAMES OUT OF THE HOUSEHOLD AT THE AGUADA *** - his sister Maria Adelina, his brother Carlos Ambrosio, and his father Avelino. That is corroboration and not evidence; the evidence is the death registration. *** All eight are INDEX-LEVEL. ***  *** THE IMAGE WAS OPENED THE SAME DAY IT WAS CALLED AN ERRAND, and the weak link is now PRIMARY. *** Act No. 246, film 008165205 image 01604. He died at *** six in the morning of 1 March 1921, at the calle JUAN PAULLIER, Montevideo ***, and the act gives him as *** 'de nacionalidad ORIENTAL, NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO, de SESENTA Y NUEVE ANOS de edad, de estado casado, de profesion RENTISTA, a consecuencia de CARCINOMA DE LA VEJIGA, segun consta del certificado del Dr. LUSSICH' ***, and then: *** 'Que el finado era hijo de AVELINO LERENA, fallecido, y de AMBROSIA TREIBEL, fallecida.' *** *** BORN AT MONTEVIDEO - which is where Pedro Alberto Ysabelino was baptised, at the Aguada, and NOT where his own children were born. *** The declarants were not family: JUAN MIRAMONTE, fifty, of 18 de Julio, and PEDRO FERNANDEZ, forty-eight, of Cerrito 230. *** AND THE ACT COUNTS HIS CHILDREN: 'era casado con Maria Ines Larriera, de cuya union quedan NUEVE HIJOS llamados: Maria Adelina, Zelmira, ELEIZA, Alberto, Carlos, Maria Ines, Maria Consuelo, Maria Antonieta y Miguel Avelino.' *** Eight of the nine were already found in the civil index; *** the third is a daughter no index here has matched, and her name is not securely read *** - ELEIZA or ELOIZA. *** The age of 69 is fifteen days early against a birth of 16 March 1852, which is what an age given by two neighbours looks like. *** RENTISTA is a fact about this branch nothing else here records: by 1921 it lived on property income.

name: Mercedes LERENA (godmother, 1880)
source: Named at the baptisms of Maria Carlota and Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 8 Mar 1880 (this archive placed it at the UNION until 21 Sep 2026, on the index's place field; the act says 'esta Basilica menor y Catedral'); ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713378 image 02598
note: *** ANOTHER LERENA WOMAN, found 14 September 2026 - very likely a SISTER OF JOSEFA and so another daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel. *** She stood godmother with Juan Arechaga to Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 8 March 1880 - and the child carries her name. Nothing else in this archive names her.  *** 'NOTHING ELSE IN THIS ARCHIVE NAMES HER' IS NO LONGER TRUE, 21 September 2026. *** A sister of Josefa of exactly this name is now documented: MERCEDES MICAELA LERENA TRAIBEL, born 8 May 1863, christened at the Union on 25 September 1866, daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel. *** THE TWO ROWS ARE NOT MERGED, AND THE REASON IS AGE. *** This godmother stood at a font in March 1880, when Mercedes Micaela was sixteen. That is possible and not impossible, and the surname, the parish and the family are all right - the niece is even named for her. But a sixteen-year-old godmother is an inference, and the act that would settle it is the 1880 baptism itself, whose full-text transcript this archive has read without recovering the godmother's age or parentage. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713378 image 02598, folios 411-412, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo - the two baptisms of 8 March 1880. Priest RAFAEL YEREGUI. *** THE TEST NAMED IN THIS ROW HAS NOW BEEN RUN, AND IT DOES NOT SETTLE ANYTHING. *** The row said the 1880 act 'would have to give her age or her parents' before she could be joined to Mercedes Micaela Lerena Traibel. The plate was read on 21 September 2026 and *** it gives NEITHER *** - only 'fueron padrinos JUAN [Arechaga] y MERCEDES LERENA, a quienes instruyo'. *** So the two rows stay apart, and the reason is now a read page rather than an unopened one. ***  *** AND THE PARISH WAS WRONG, CORRECTED 21 September 2026 OFF THE PLATE. *** This archive placed these 1880 baptisms at the *** UNION ***, which is what the index's place field says. The act itself reads *** 'con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco DE ESTA BASILICA MENOR Y CATEDRAL DE MONTEVIDEO, bautice solemnemente EN ELLA a Maria Carlota' ***. *** They were baptised in the CATEDRAL BASILICA, not at the Union. ***

name: Maria Carlota MORATORIO Lerena
source: Named at the baptisms of Maria Carlota and Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 8 Mar 1880 (this archive placed it at the UNION until 21 Sep 2026, on the index's place field; the act says 'esta Basilica menor y Catedral'); ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713378 image 02598
note: Daughter of Fernando Moratorio and Josefa Lerena Traibel, baptised at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 8 March 1880 with her sister. *** "PROBABLY TWINS" IS AN UNTESTED INFERENCE AND IS FLAGGED AS ONE, 20 September 2026. *** It rests on nothing but a shared baptism date, and that reasoning was disproved elsewhere in this family on the same day: Ana Rosario and Alfredo Justiniano Lerena Traibel were baptised together at San Francisco de Asis in 1858 and were born twenty-one months apart. *** The test is cheap and unrun: *** the full-text transcript of these two acts should state each girl's own birth date, as the 1858 pair do. A granddaughter of Avelino Lerena. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713378 image 02598, folios 411-412, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo - the two baptisms of 8 March 1880. Priest RAFAEL YEREGUI. *** THE TEST THIS ROW NAMED AS CHEAP AND UNRUN HAS BEEN RUN, AND 'PROBABLY TWINS' IS CONFIRMED. *** The act states her own birth: *** 'que nacio el VEINTE Y CUATRO DE FEBRERO ultimo' ***. Her sister's act, on the facing folio, states the same day. *** THEY ARE TWINS, born 24 FEBRUARY 1880 and carried to the font twelve days later. *** Her godparents were FRANCISCO AZANOLA and MANUELA OTONDO - not, as this archive half-assumed, the same pair as her sister's. The act also gives the paternal grandparents FERNANDO and NICOLASA TORRES and the maternal AVELINO and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, and calls the parents 'orientales'.  *** AND THE PARISH WAS WRONG, CORRECTED 21 September 2026 OFF THE PLATE. *** This archive placed these 1880 baptisms at the *** UNION ***, which is what the index's place field says. The act itself reads *** 'con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco DE ESTA BASILICA MENOR Y CATEDRAL DE MONTEVIDEO, bautice solemnemente EN ELLA a Maria Carlota' ***. *** They were baptised in the CATEDRAL BASILICA, not at the Union. ***

name: Maria de las Mercedes MORATORIO Lerena
source: Named at the baptisms of Maria Carlota and Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 8 Mar 1880 (this archive placed it at the UNION until 21 Sep 2026, on the index's place field; the act says 'esta Basilica menor y Catedral'); ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713378 image 02598
note: Daughter of Fernando Moratorio and Josefa Lerena Traibel, baptised at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 8 March 1880 with her sister. Her godmother was MERCEDES LERENA, for whom she is named. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713378 image 02598, folios 411-412, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo - the two baptisms of 8 March 1880. Priest RAFAEL YEREGUI. *** SHE AND HER SISTER WERE BOTH BORN 24 FEBRUARY 1880 - read off both acts. *** 'que nacio el veinte y cuatro de Febrero ultimo, hija legitima de Fernando Moratorio y Josefa Le[rena] ... fueron padrinos JUAN [Arechaga y Mercedes] LERENA'. *** So the twins reading is right here and was wrong in 1858 ***, where Ana Rosario and Alfredo Justiniano were carried to the same font twenty-one months apart. Same family, same habit of batch-baptism, and the shared date means something in one case and nothing in the other - which is exactly why it had to be read rather than assumed.  *** AND THE PARISH WAS WRONG, CORRECTED 21 September 2026 OFF THE PLATE. *** This archive placed these 1880 baptisms at the *** UNION ***, which is what the index's place field says. The act itself reads *** 'con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco DE ESTA BASILICA MENOR Y CATEDRAL DE MONTEVIDEO, bautice solemnemente EN ELLA a Maria Carlota' ***. *** They were baptised in the CATEDRAL BASILICA, not at the Union. ***

name: Alfredo Justiniano LERENA Traibel
source: Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, marriage of 3 Feb 1892 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K; and his own baptism, San Francisco de Asis, 12 Mar 1858 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, and a brother of Josefa - found 14 September 2026. *** Married HERMENEGILDA CAROLINA GAVARRO at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 3 February 1892, aged thirty-five. *** THE MARRIAGE NEEDED A DISPENSATION FOR CONSANGUINITY - third degree with atingencia to the second - granted personally by MARIANO SOLER, the first Archbishop of Montevideo. *** He is written GERENA in his own marriage act while his father is written LORENA in the same sentence: a seventh spelling for this family. *** HIS BAPTISM IS FOUND: 12 March 1858, San Francisco de Asis, with his sister Ana Rosario. *** It gives his full name ALFREDO JUSTINIANO and his grandparents Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez. *** AND IT RESOLVES A PUZZLE: the JUSTINIANO looked like an echo of Justiniana Lenguas, who married into the other branch - a tidy connection that would have been wrong. He is named for his GODFATHER, JUSTINIANO LAVALLEJA, on the same line of the same act. *** This row used to end: "His baptismal age of 1858 sits oddly against the 35 he gave at his 1892 marriage, which would imply 1857; ages at marriage are the weakest date in genealogy." *** THE ODDNESS WAS THIS ARCHIVE'S, NOT THE RECORD'S - 20 September 2026. *** He was not born in 1858. The act read here on 14 September says so outright, and the sentence was never lifted off the page: *** "que nacio el dia DOS de OCTUBRE ... cincuenta y seis" *** - born *** 2 OCTOBER 1856 ***, and baptised at seventeen months. *** AND THAT MAKES THE MARRIAGE AGE EXACT. *** On 3 February 1892 a man born 2 October 1856 is thirty-five, which is precisely what he told the priest. The record and the age never disagreed; this register had written the baptism date into the birth column and then blamed the discrepancy on the record. *** Re-read off the image 20 September: *** film 007713686 image 2847, which also confirms the paternal grandparents "Don Sancho Lerena y Dona Maria Fernandez", the maternal "Don Juan Traibel y Dona Ysabel Centeno", and the godparents Justiniano Lavalleja and Dona Polonia Traibel.  *** HIS WIFE'S SURNAME WAS WRONG HERE FOR A WEEK, AND IS CORRECTED OFF THE IMAGE: SHE IS A GAVAZZO, NOT A GAVARRO, and her mother a SUAREZ, not a Juarez. *** The 1892 act was held from a machine full-text transcript; the image was opened on 21 September 2026 and reads 'hija legitima de Don GERONIMO GAVAZZO y Dona CAROLINA SUAREZ'. The same image confirms what this row already said - 'Don ALFREDO LERENA, soltero, de TREINTA Y CINCO anos de edad'. *** AND THE END OF HIS LIFE HAS A CEILING AT LAST. *** Hermenegilda died at Montevideo on 20 June 1940 *** 'de estado VIUDA' ***, so *** he died between February 1892 and June 1940 ***, aged somewhere between thirty-five and eighty-three. No death record for him has been found.

name: Hermenegilda Carolina GAVAZZO (de LERENA)
source: Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, marriage of 3 Feb 1892 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K; IMAGE READ 21 September 2026 - film 007713383 image 02601; and her own Montevideo death registration No. 632 of 20 June 1940 - IMAGE READ, film 008166249 image 01900, index ark 1:1:XSXM-NTHF
note: Married Alfredo Lerena Traibel at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 3 February 1892, aged thirty. Daughter of Don Geronimo GAVAZZO and Dona Carolina SUAREZ - so the plate, read 21 September 2026; this row said "Gavarro" and "Juarez" until then, on a machine transcript. *** She and her husband were COUSINS - the act dispenses an impediment of the third degree of consanguinity with atingencia to the second. ***  *** THE SURNAME IS CORRECTED OFF THE IMAGE, 21 September 2026. *** This archive held it from a MACHINE FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT of the 1892 marriage act and never opened the page. The page was opened - film 007713383 image 02601, folio 340 - and the act reads *** 'hija legitima de Don GERONIMO GAVAZZO y Dona CAROLINA SUAREZ' ***. *** GAVAZZO, not "Gavarro"; SUAREZ, not "Juarez". *** It is corroborated independently by Hermenegilda's own Montevideo death registration of 20 June 1940, certificate 632, read off film 008166249 image 01900, which writes her *** HERMENEGILDA GAVAZZO DE LERENA *** and her parents *** Geronimo Gavazzo and Carolina Suarez ***. Two images, forty-eight years apart, against one machine transcript.  *** AND SHE HAS A DEATH, found the same day: 20 JUNE 1940, at MONTEVIDEO. *** The act says she died at R. Masini 3273, *** 'de estado VIUDA' ***, *** 'a consecuencia de FRACTURA DEL CUELLO DEL FEMUR' *** - a broken hip, which for a woman of about seventy-eight in 1940 is usually the end. Certificate 632, registered by Jose M. Reyes Corvalan. *** SO ALFREDO JUSTINIANO DIED BEFORE 20 JUNE 1940 ***, which is the first thing this archive has ever known about the end of his life. She was a widow, and the marriage had lasted at least into its fifth decade.

name: Ana Rosario LERENA Traibel
source: San Francisco de Asis, Montevideo, baptisms of 12 Mar 1858 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713686 image 02847
note: Daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel, baptised at San Francisco de Asis on 12 March 1858 with her brother Alfredo Justiniano. *** THEY WERE NOT TWINS, AND THIS ROW SAID THEY PROBABLY WERE UNTIL 20 SEPTEMBER 2026. *** Both acts were re-read off the image that day - film 007713686 image 2847 - and each states its own birth. Hers: *** "que nacio el dia CATORCE de ENERO ... cincuenta y cinco" - 14 JANUARY 1855 ***. Her brother's: 2 October 1856. *** They are twenty-one months apart and were carried to the font together, she at three years old and he at seventeen months. *** "Probably twins" was an inference from a shared baptism date, and the acts refute it. *** THIS FAMILY BAPTISED IN BATCHES, YEARS LATE, MORE THAN ONCE: *** Avelino's son Alejandro was christened at La Mauricia in January 1846 among a group of children of various ages, and here are two more, three years and seventeen months old. A granddaughter of Sancho. *** Her godparents were CONSTANTINO and ANA LAVALLEJA. *** *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713686 image 02847, folio 176, San Francisco de Asis - the two acts of 12 March 1858 that attach the Lerena Traibel branch to Sancho. *** EVERY NAME ON THEM SURVIVES THE CHECK, word for word. *** *** AND HER BIRTH DATE IS NOW READ, NOT TRANSCRIBED: *** 'que nacio el dia CATORCE DE ENERO de mil ocho cientos cincuenta y cinco, hija legitima de Don Avelino Lerena y de Dona Ambrosia Traibel, NATURALES DE ESTA REPUBLICA.'

name: Justiniano LAVALLEJA
source: San Francisco de Asis, Montevideo, baptisms of 12 Mar 1858 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713686 image 02847
note: *** Godfather to Alfredo JUSTINIANO Lerena Traibel at San Francisco de Asis on 12 March 1858, and the man the child is named for. *** LAVALLEJA is one of the great names of Uruguayan independence - Juan Antonio Lavalleja led the Treinta y Tres Orientales in 1825. *** NO RELATIONSHIP TO HIM IS CLAIMED HERE: Lavalleja is a surname, not a proof. *** What the record shows is that this family stood at fonts with Lavallejas, as it had with a RIVERA in 1831 and married an ORIBE in 1836. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713686 image 02847, folio 176, San Francisco de Asis - the two acts of 12 March 1858 that attach the Lerena Traibel branch to Sancho. *** EVERY NAME ON THEM SURVIVES THE CHECK, word for word. *** *** THIS WAS THE NAME MOST AT RISK AND IT HOLDS. *** A machine that meets a famous Uruguayan surname will write it whether or not the page says so - that is exactly how FRUCTUOSO RIVERA got printed over the 1831 act's own FRUTUSO RIBERA. Here the page says 'JUSTINIANO LAVALLEJA', and it says it in a hand that also spells LERENA and TRAIBEL correctly on the same line.

name: Bernabe LERENA (1911 dispensation)
source: Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records July-August 1911 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-GS3N-1 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713362 image 02473; and Flores. Birth Records 1916-1925 - act No. 10 of 1922, Anibal Marino Pelaez, born 3 March 1922, Sexta Seccion of Flores; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-8SX8, DGS film 008165367 item 6 image 195 - FULL-TEXT found and PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the Trinidad, Flores birthplace sweep, pages 1-4, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***; and Santisima Trinidad, Baptism Records 1886-1888 (item 1 of DGS film 008164291, 211 images), image 183 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-NQ75-T), the baptism of 25 April 1889 - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT, THE PLATE NOT OPENED *** 29 October 2026, found by scanning the volume for the surname with its wider spellings; and Santisima Trinidad, Baptism Records 1889-1894 (item 2 of DGS film 008164291, 256 images), image 247 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-NQQ5-W), the baptism of Elisa Cayetana LERENA Cardozo - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT, THE PLATE NOT OPENED *** 29 October 2026, found by scanning the volume for the surname with its wider spellings
note: *** A LERENA BROTHER, found 14 September 2026 in a dispensation that draws its own family tree. *** Married FLORINDA CARDOZO; father of CUSTODIO LERENA. His sister MARIA LERENA married Florinda's brother ELISEO CARDOZO - so two Lerena siblings married two Cardozo siblings, and in 1911 their children petitioned to marry each other as DOUBLE FIRST COUSINS. Nothing attaches him to any branch in this register. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713362 image 02473 - and the folio is not prose but 'Esquema explicativo de los grados de parentesco', TWO KINSHIP DIAGRAMS the priest drew himself to prove the impediment. The diagrams read 'Bernabe Lerena casose con FLORINDA CARDOZO' and 'Florinda Cardozo casada con Bernabe Lerena'. *** His own father is named at the apex of the first schema and is a person this archive had never held. *** *** HE HAS AN AGE, A TRADE, AN ADDRESS AND A DAUGHTER, 9 October 2026. *** His grandson's birth act of 10 March 1922 names the child's maternal grandparents as '*** Don BERNABE LERENA, hacendado, de SESENTA anos de edad, y Dona FLORINDA CARDOZO, de CINCUENTA Y CUATRO anos, casados, orientales y domiciliados en esta Seccion ***' - so born about *** 1862 ***, a landholder, living in the *** Sexta Seccion of Flores *** and alive in March 1922. *** AND THE CHILD'S MOTHER, FLORINDA JUANA LERENA, IS HIS DAUGHTER *** - a sister for Custodio, and the row that joins the 1911 dispensation to the 1913 one. *** HE IS NOT THE BERNABE OF TRINIDAD ***, who was born about 1835; twenty-seven years apart. *** HIS OWN MARRIAGE IS DATED: 22 MARCH 1888 at Santisima Trinidad ***, where the index gives him born about *** 1863 ***, son of *** BERNABE LERENA and CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***, marrying *** FLORINDA CARDOSO ***. Found 11 October 2026, index only. *** THE DOUBLE WEDDING OF 25 APRIL 1889, found 11 October 2026. *** On one day at *** Santisima Trinidad ***, *** TWO LERENA SISTERS MARRIED TWO CARDOZO BROTHERS ***: *** MARIA LERENA ***, born about 1867, to *** ELISEO CARDOSO ***, and *** CASIMIRA LERENA ***, born 29 July 1867 [corrected 26 October 2026; this row first had 'about 1869' from the index], to *** JUAN BASILIO CARDOSO ***. Both are daughters of *** BERNABE LERENA and CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***. *** AND THIS IS WHAT THE 1911 DISPENSATION WAS ABOUT. *** That expediente calls *** CUSTODIO LERENA and EMA CARDOZO 'double first cousins' *** and this archive has had the diagrams for weeks without the marriages that produced them. Here they are: a *** LERENA brother and his LERENA sisters *** married a *** CARDOZO sister and her CARDOZO brothers *** - Bernabe the younger to Florinda Cardozo on 22 March 1888, then Maria and Casimira to Eliseo and Juan Basilio on 25 April 1889. *** TWO BLOOD PATHS BETWEEN THE NEXT GENERATION, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT 'DOUBLE' MEANS. *** *** INDEX ONLY; the acts have not been opened and which Cardozo fathered Ema is not yet shown. *** *** A BAPTISM THAT PROBABLY IS HIS, 26 October 2026: *** Bernabe Concilo Lerena Pelaez, born 15 July 1861, a son of Bernabe Lerena and Casimira Pelaez, the couple whose daughter Maria is this man's sister; the dispensation's age puts him a year later. Not merged. *** CALLED 'BERNABE LERENA (HIJO)' ON HIS SON CUSTODIO'S BAPTISM, 25 APRIL 1889, 29 October 2026: *** with Florinda Cardoso, and his parents Bernabe and Casimira Pelaez. (Machine transcript, image 183.) *** TWO MORE CHILDREN, 29 October 2026: *** Rodolfo Bernardo (born 20 August 1892; godparents Manuel Vaquero and Aurora Lerena) and Elisa Cayetana (born 7 August 1894; godparents Pedro Cardoso and Natalia Lerena); with Custodio (1889), three children held. (Machine transcripts, images 168 and 247.)

name: Zelmira Carlota LERENA LARRIERA (m. Adolfo CORDERO)

note: *** TESTED AND PLACED, 14 September 2026 - and she is NOT ours. *** Born 4 NOVEMBER 1880 in the Departamento de SAN JOSE, daughter of *** ALBERTO LERENA and MARIA INES LARRIERA ***; married ADOLFO CORDERO at Montevideo on 28 FEBRUARY 1901; died at Montevideo 4 JANUARY 1945. Children ADOLFO ANGEL FAUSTINO (b.1905, the San Jose baptism that found her), MARIA ZELMIRA (b.1903, d.1984) and MARIA EUGENIA. *** She was flagged because the shape was right - a Uruguayan Lerena woman married to an Argentine in the decade this archive cares about. The shape was right and the substance is not: she has a father, a birthplace and a date, and none of them touches Pablo Armando. *** *** BUT HER FATHER IS WORTH A SECOND LOOK, AND IS NOT MERGED. *** ALBERTO LERENA, fathering a daughter in 1880, would be the right age to be ALBERTO OCTAVIO LERENA LENGUAS - born Montevideo 22 March 1850, son of Luis and Justiniana, and so a grandson of Sancho. He would be thirty. *** NOTHING JOINS THEM but a forename and an age, which is precisely the evidence that produced the two Arturos. *** If it held, Zelmira would be a great-granddaughter of Sancho - and that is a hypothesis to test, not a line to draw.  *** 'SHE IS NOT OURS' IS RETRACTED, 21 September 2026. SHE IS OURS. *** This row named the one test that would change its own verdict - who her father Alberto Lerena was - and guessed ALBERTO OCTAVIO LERENA LENGUAS. *** IT IS THE OTHER GRANDFATHER. *** Alberto Lerena's own Montevideo death registration of 2 March 1921, certificate 246, names his wife MARIA INES LARRIERA and his parents AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TREIBEL. So her father is *** PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO LERENA TRAIBEL, baptised at the Aguada on 21 November 1852 ***, and *** ZELMIRA IS A GREAT-GRANDDAUGHTER OF SANCHO *** - which is what this row said would follow if the link held. It held by a different route. *** THE LINK IS ONE RECORD AND IT IS INDEX-LEVEL: *** the 1921 image has not been opened, and that is now an errand. See data/alberto-lerena-larriera.tsv.  *** AND THE LINK IS NO LONGER INDEX-LEVEL. *** Within the hour the 1921 image was opened - film 008165205 image 01604 - and it names her father's parents as AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TREIBEL in his own hand-written act, *** and names HER among his nine children: 'Maria Adelina, ZELMIRA, Eleiza, Alberto, Carlos, Maria Ines, Maria Consuelo, Maria Antonieta y Miguel Avelino'. *** The chain from her to Sancho now rests on an image at every step that matters. *** AND HER MARRIAGE IS FOUND, 9 October 2026. *** Entry N. 7057, *** 1 FEBRUARY 1901 ***: the Archbishop dispensed *** DON ADOLFO CORDERO *** the impediment of *** THIRD GRADE of consanguinity WITH ATTINGENCY TO THE SECOND, by the unequal lateral line ***, with which he was declared bound to *** DONA ZELMIRA CARLOTA LERENA, feligresa de la METROPOLITANA ***. *** SHE MARRIED A BLOOD RELATIVE, AND THAT IS A FACT ABOUT HER ANCESTRY RATHER THAN HER LIFE *** - the Church computed the degree before it would dispense, so the entry constrains her pedigree even though it names no parent. *** THIS ARCHIVE ONCE WROTE HER OFF *** as 'tested and placed - and she is not ours', and corrected that; here she is on a record of her own. *** AND HER MARRIAGE ACT WAS READ IN FULL ON 9 OCTOBER 2026, and it moves the date. *** Headed *** 'Matrimonio de Cordero y Lorena' ***: on *** 28 FEBRUARY 1904 *** at the Iglesia de *** Nuestra Senora de Lourdes ***, La Union, before Bishop *** Ricardo Jara ***, she married *** D. ADOLFO MAXIMO CORDERO - soltero, ARGENTINO, MEDICO, twenty-eight, of SAN JOSE, legitimate son of D. ADOLFO M. CORDERO and Dona CASIMIRA CHAVARRIA ***. She is *** soltera, oriental, TWENTY years old, of CALLE CERRO LARGO 230 ***, and *** hija legitima de D. Alberto [S]erena y Dona Maria Ines Larriera ***. *** THIS REGISTER SAYS SHE MARRIED IN 1901 AND THE ACT SAYS 1904 *** - same day, same month. The book runs 1902-1934 and the entry above it is dated May 1902, so *** 1901 is impossible and the act is primary ***. The dispensation of 1 February 1901 cleared them three years before they married. *** AND HER AGE DOES NOT FIT EITHER: *** twenty in February 1904 means born about 1883-84, not 4 November 1880. *** Both are recorded and neither is preferred. *** *** HER PARENTS ARE NOW ON A PRIMARY RECORD *** rather than an index - and the act writes her father SERENA and her mother, as a witness four lines later, LERENA.

source: Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion, Montevideo - baptism of 12 May 1827 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSFQ-2 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713376 image 00601; and the Catedral baptism of her grandson Domingo Rodriguez de Carvallo, 25 October 1840 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSFY-L; and the SAME plate re-read 11 October 2026 during a site-wide audit - film 007713376 image 01689, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSFY-L, deepzoom apid TH-909-52377-68331-65
note: Wife of Mayor Don Joaquin Ruiz de Carvallo; "la finada" by May 1827. *** AND SHE IS THE "DONA JUANA DEL ESPIRITU SANTO" of the 1840 act - *** named there as Joaquin's wife and a native of the Colonia del Sacramento. A devotional epithet and a surname can belong to one woman. Recorded as a reading, not a finding - the two acts do not say so themselves. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713376 image 00601, folio 150 - the baptism of 12 May 1827 at the Iglesia Matriz de San Felipe y Santiago de Montevideo. Materna...' - she survives the check as the paternal grandmother. *** 'PROBABLY' IS WITHDRAWN AND THE TWO ROWS ARE NOW ONE, 11 October 2026. *** This register carried her twice: here as JUANA SUAREZ, wife of Mayor Joaquin, and separately as *** 'Dona Juana del ESPIRITU SANTO' ***, entered as the wife of a *** 'Don Domingo Rodriguez' *** who turns out not to exist. *** THE PLATE OF THE 1840 ACT READS JOAQUIN, NOT DOMINGO *** - so both rows described the same slot, the mother of Capitan Antonio, and the obstacle to joining them was a misread forename rather than anything about her. *** BOTH ACTS NAME HER AS ANTONIO'S MOTHER: *** the 1827 baptism of her granddaughter Lucinda Gregoria gives the paternal grandparents as *** 'Joaquin Ruiz de Carvallo y Juana Suarez' ***; the 1840 baptism of her grandson Domingo gives them as *** 'D. note: *** BORN INTO SLAVERY IN THIS FAMILY'S HOUSEHOLD, 24 September 1812. *** *** "bautice solemnemente a MARIA MERCEDES, que nacio antes de ayer, NEGRA ESCLAVA DE DON SANCHO LERENA Y DE DONA MARIA FERNANDEZ, hija de JUANA. Madrina Catalina Martinez." *** *** She was born in the same month the padron was taken that counted four enslaved people in that house and named none of them. *** *** Nothing is known of what became of her. *** *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713375 image 02628, folio 136, Montevideo Catedral - the baptism of 26 September 1812. *** READ OFF THE PLATE, and every word of this row holds: *** 'bautice solemnemente a MARIA MERCEDES, que nacio ANTES DE AYER, hija de JUANA, negra esclava de D.n Sancho Lerena y de D.a Maria Fernandez: MADRINA CATALINA MARTINEZ, a quien instrui; y por verdad lo firme.' name: Juan Carlos GONZALEZ LERENA (m. 1920s, Montevideo)
source: Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records 1856-1932, 8 Nov 192- - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-NNW8 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713367 image 02860, folio 391
note: *** CHECKED AND EXCLUDED, 15 September 2026 - he is the only 'Juan Carlos Lerena' in FamilySearch's entire full-text corpus apart from a 2001 death record. *** The Vicar General "dispenso a Don Juan Carlos Gonzalez Lerena las tres conciliares proclamas en el matrimonio que intenta contraer con ... Concepcion Petrona Urbano". *** LERENA IS HIS SECOND SURNAME - his mother's - not his father's. *** That is the same shape as the only Juan Carlos Lerena in all of Geneanet, a "del Campo Lerena". *** Pablo Armando's father must carry LERENA as the PATERNAL surname and must have been born by about the 1850s to father a son in 1882. This man is marrying in the 1920s. *** *** Recorded so that the next reader who runs this search does not have to spend an hour excluding him. ***  *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, AND THE COMPOUND SURNAME IS REALLY THERE. *** Film 007713367 image 02860, folio 391, entry *** No. 14610 ***: 'El OCHO DE NOVIEMBRE de mil novecientos VEINTE Y DOS, el Rmo. Sr. Vicario General ... en uso de sus facultades dispensó a Don *** JUAN CARLOS GONZALEZ LERENA *** las tres conciliares proclamas en el matrimonio que intenta contraer con ...'. *** So the date is 8 NOVEMBER 1922, not merely 'the 1920s', and the register of Montevideo dispensations numbers it 14610. *** THE BRIDE'S NAME IS ONLY PARTLY LEGIBLE *** and is not written down here as a reading: the words run '...cepcion Petrona' and then a surname this archive cannot settle between URBANO and a similar hand. *** IT IS NOT GUESSED. *** WHY THIS MAN IS IN THIS REGISTER AT ALL: he is a JUAN CARLOS, which is the forename this whole archive turns on *** - Pablo Armando's father is named Juan Carlos Lerena on the 1908 enrolment card. *** THIS IS NOT HIM AND WAS NEVER CLAIMED TO BE: *** this man carries GONZALEZ as his paternal surname and LERENA as his mother's, and he is marrying at Montevideo in 1922, forty years after Pablo Armando was born at Rosario. He is kept because a Juan Carlos with LERENA anywhere in his name is worth being able to rule out on the record rather than meeting again in five years' time.

name: Rafael LLERENA (Buenos Aires, b. c.1881)
source: San Nicolas de Bari, Retiro, Buenos Aires, baptism of his son, 30 Aug 1910 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:939D-GD9T-LM - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 004571164 image 00201, folio 370
note: *** AN ARGENTINE-BORN LLERENA HOUSEHOLD IN BUENOS AIRES, found 15 September 2026 and new to this archive. *** "bautizo solemnemente ... a JUAN CARLOS que nacio el dia diez de Julio del ano mil novecientos diez, hijo legitimo de D. RAFAEL LLERENA natural del Pais de veinte y nueve anos de edad, y de Dona MARIA CARLOTA AMADEO LASTRA natural del Pais de veinte y siete anos, domiciliados en Calle Cerrito 535." *** His son is called JUAN CARLOS - which is why this record surfaced at all, in a search for Pablo Armando's father. *** *** The son is NOT that man: he was born in 1910. *** *** But the FATHER is the kind of person this archive has been looking for *** - a Llerena born in Argentina about 1881, within a year of Pablo Armando, living in central Buenos Aires. *** Nothing connects him here. He is recorded as a lead, not a relative. *** He sits beside the other unresolved Argentine namesake already in this register, Gilberto Lerena b.1879 who landed in 1928.  *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, and it is a printed form, filled in, at the PARROQUIA DE SAN NICOLAS, BUENOS AIRES, ANO DE 1910. *** Film 004571164 image 00201, folio 370. *** THE CHILD IS A JUAN CARLOS. *** 'bautizo solemnemente a JUAN CARLOS LLERENA, que nacio el dia DIEZ Y SEIS DE JULIO del ano mil novecientos diez, hijo legitimo de D.r D. RAFAEL LLERENA, natural del PAIS, de VEINTE Y NUEVE anos de edad, y de D.a MARIA CARLOTA AMADEO LASTRA, natural del Pais, de VEINTE Y SIETE anos de edad.' *** So this row's estimate of c.1881 is confirmed by the act *** - twenty-nine in July 1910 - and the double L is his own, in a Buenos Aires parish in 1910. *** WHY IT MATTERS, AND WHY IT IS NOT WHAT THE ARCHIVE IS LOOKING FOR: *** this act creates a JUAN CARLOS LLERENA at Buenos Aires, and Juan Carlos Lerena is the name on Pablo Armando's 1908 enrolment card. *** This child was born in 1910. Pablo Armando was born in 1882. The child cannot be his father and is not claimed to be. *** He is recorded so that the next search which turns up a Juan Carlos Llerena in Buenos Aires meets a dated row rather than a fresh hope. *** AND THE ACT NAMES A SECOND LLERENA WOMAN: *** the madrina signed it herself, in her own hand, *** 'Alejandrina Llerena' *** - and a literate woman signing a Buenos Aires parish register in 1910 is the kind of person who leaves other records. The padrino signs 'A. Lastra', which is the mother's family.

name: Victor LERENA (d.1889, alpargatero)
source: Montevideo civil death registration 1889 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-27FX-P - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 008165116 image 01442
note: *** A WHOLE BRANCH OF LERENAS THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER SEEN, found 15 September 2026 by searching FIDEL rather than the surname. *** His death registration: "ha fallecido VICTOR LERENA de nacionalidad oriental de veinte y ocho anos de edad, de estado soltero y de profesion ALPARGATERO, a consecuencia de TUBERCULOSIS PULMONAR ... el finado era hijo [de] PEDRO LORENA y JOSEFA SEGUEIRA, orientales, FINADOS. Abuelos paternos FIDEL LERENA y MARIA RUEDAS; maternos Jose Seguera y Ramona." *** He died in hospital at twenty-eight, single, of tuberculosis, and the declaration was made DE OFICIO - by the authorities, not by family. *** *** An alpargatero is a maker of rope-soled shoes. *** Every other Lerena this archive has placed in Montevideo is a hacendado, a juez de paz, a major or a senator's family. *** This is the same surname at the other end of that city. *** *** WHETHER THIS FIDEL IS SANCHO'S SON IS NOT ESTABLISHED. *** Sancho's Fidel was born about 1799 and the Geneanet trees give him a death in 1822, at twenty-two or twenty-three. *** For this to be the same man, Pedro would have to be born by 1822 and fathering Victor at about forty. *** That is tight but possible, and the tree's 1822 is tree-only and has never been tested against a Montevideo burial. *** The alternative is a second Fidel Lerena at Montevideo, which nothing rules out. *** *** Recorded as a branch to test, not as a descent. *** *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 008165116 image 01442, folio 94 - Montevideo civil death registration No. 622 of 1889. *** THE ACT GIVES A CAUSE OF DEATH THE TRANSCRIPT NEVER CARRIED: 'a consecuencia de TUBERCULOSIS PULMONAR, segun consta del certificado medico'. *** His trade is confirmed in the priest's - the registrar's - own hand: *** ALPARGATERO ***. And the registration is *** 'de oficio' ***, an official declaration rather than one made by kin, which is why no relative signs it. *** THE ACT RUNS TO THREE GENERATIONS: *** 'el finado era hijo de PEDRO LERENA y JOSEFA SEGUEIRA, orientales, FINADOS. Abuelos [paternos] FIDEL LERENA y MARIA RUEDAS: MATERNOS JOSE SEGUEIRA y RAMONA...'

name: Pedro LORENA (father of Victor, d. before 1889)
source: Montevideo civil death registration 1889 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-27FX-P - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 008165116 image 01442
note: *** Named on his son's death registration of 1889 as already dead - "el finado era hijo [de] PEDRO LORENA y JOSEFA SEGUEIRA, orientales, FINADOS". *** *** His own parents are given: FIDEL LERENA and MARIA RUEDAS. *** The surname is written LORENA for him and LERENA for his son and his father in the same sentence, which is this family's ordinary behaviour in the records. *** WHETHER THIS FIDEL IS SANCHO'S SON IS NOT ESTABLISHED. *** Sancho's Fidel was born about 1799 and the Geneanet trees give him a death in 1822, at twenty-two or twenty-three. *** For this to be the same man, Pedro would have to be born by 1822 and fathering Victor at about forty. *** That is tight but possible, and the tree's 1822 is tree-only and has never been tested against a Montevideo burial. *** The alternative is a second Fidel Lerena at Montevideo, which nothing rules out. *** *** Recorded as a branch to test, not as a descent. *** *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 008165116 image 01442, folio 94 - Montevideo civil death registration No. 622 of 1889. *** THIS ROW'S CLAIM ABOUT THE SPELLING IS WRONG, AND THE PLATE SHOWS IT. *** The row said the surname 'is written LORENA for him and LERENA for his son and his father in the same sentence'. *** In the body of the act he is written LERENA ***, exactly like his son and his father: 'era hijo de PEDRO LERENA y Josefa Segueira'. *** LORENA is the MARGIN heading - 'Num. 622 Victor Lorena' *** - which is the clerk's index entry, not the sentence. So the family's ordinary confusion of L and Ll and Lor is real, but this particular instance of it was the archive reading a margin as though it were the text.

name: Fidel LERENA (m. Maria Ruedas)
source: Montevideo civil death registration 1889 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-27FX-P - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 008165116 image 01442
note: *** A FIDEL LERENA WITH A WIFE AND A GRANDSON, named on a Montevideo death registration of 1889. *** *** "Abuelos paternos FIDEL LERENA y MARIA RUEDAS" *** - the paternal grandparents of Victor Lerena, who died that year at twenty-eight. *** FIDEL is a rare forename in this family and appears exactly once elsewhere: Sancho Llerena's son, born about 1799. *** And this archive worked out only yesterday where that name came from - Don Fidel Rey of Montevideo, godfather at Agustina's baptism in 1795. *** WHETHER THIS FIDEL IS SANCHO'S SON IS NOT ESTABLISHED. *** Sancho's Fidel was born about 1799 and the Geneanet trees give him a death in 1822, at twenty-two or twenty-three. *** For this to be the same man, Pedro would have to be born by 1822 and fathering Victor at about forty. *** That is tight but possible, and the tree's 1822 is tree-only and has never been tested against a Montevideo burial. *** The alternative is a second Fidel Lerena at Montevideo, which nothing rules out. *** *** Recorded as a branch to test, not as a descent. *** This row said "THE TEST IS CHEAP AND HAS NOT BEEN RUN: a Montevideo marriage of FIDEL LERENA to MARIA RUEDAS, and a burial for Fidel around 1822." *** IT WAS RUN ON 20 SEPTEMBER 2026 AND BOTH HALVES CAME BACK EMPTY. *** No marriage of a Fidel Lerena to a Maria Rueda or Ruedas is indexed for Uruguay - control: the same query shape on Luis and Juanico returns the marriage act of 19 December 1864 as its first result. And no burial of a Fidel Lerena between 1815 and 1840 - control: Rodriguez in that window returns 62,026 records with real burials, so the shelf is not empty. *** THE SURPRISE IS WHICH WAY IT CUTS. *** The tree death of 1822 was the one thing that would have kept this Fidel apart from Sancho's son, and *** it is not in the record either ***. The two are still NOT merged - an unevidenced death is not evidence of survival - but nothing now separates them except the silence. See data/fs-session-2026-09-20.tsv. *** THE GRANDSON'S DATES ARE NOW EXACT, 20 September 2026: *** Victor Lerena, born *** 1861 *** at Montevideo, died *** 10 October 1889 *** - so the "twenty-eight" this row has carried is right to the year. His father is indexed *** PEDRO LORENA ***, which is the spelling the register already holds for him. The test that would settle Fidel himself was attempted on 20 September and could not be run - the API reached for it does not filter on a spouse surname. See data/fs-session-2026-09-20.tsv. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 008165116 image 01442, folio 94 - Montevideo civil death registration No. 622 of 1889. 'Abuelos [paternos] FIDEL LERENA y MARIA RUEDAS' - on the plate, in the same hand that writes Pedro Lerena on the line above. *** Whether this Fidel is Sancho's son remains unestablished, and nothing on this plate bears on it. ***
