name: Mauricio LERENA (of Colla/Rosario, m. Casimira Montano 1837)
source: Uruguay, Marriages, ark 1:1:F21B-SZ5; and Catedral Basilica San Jose, Religious Marriage Records March 1825-September 1859 - act of 3 February 1837; DGS film 008143329 (microfilm 625330) image 87, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSKH-67KL - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Catedral Basilica San Jose, Religious Marriage Records March 1825-September 1859 - act No. 17 of 16 September 1825, before Don Joseph Andres Salvatierra, Cura y Vicario Interino; DGS film 008143329 (microfilm 625330) image 10 (indexed at 00009), ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSKH-67T7 - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Santisima Trinidad, Baptism Records October 1857 - August 1866 (film 008163892, item 3, 238 images, all re-read with the wider spellings), the entry of 9 December 1863 (image 163, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-F3CK-W) - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT, THE PLATE NOT OPENED *** 26 October 2026; and Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, burial of 12 November 1879, no. 123 (image 107, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WW-G) - *** PLATE READ *** 26 October 2026; and Flores, Death Records 1888-1930 (315 images, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q6JJ), image 147 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q6LX), the civil act no. 8 of El Totoral, 1908 - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT *** 27 October 2026, found by scanning the volume for the surname with its wider spellings; and Santisima Trinidad, Baptism Records 1881-1885 (item 4 of DGS film 008111100, 255 images), image 28 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSJB-15T5), the baptism of 27 April 1882 - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT, THE PLATE NOT OPENED *** 29 October 2026, found by scanning the volume for the surname with its wider spellings
note: *** THE PATRIARCH THIS ARCHIVE HAD RESEARCHED BUT NEVER MADE A PERSON. *** His marriage of *** 3 February 1837 at San Jose de Mayo *** gives *** birthplace COLLA *** - the old name of *** ROSARIO, COLONIA *** - father *** RAMON ***, mother *** MARIA GONZALES ***, wife *** CASIMIRA MONTANO *** (her parents Jose Montano and Ignacia Barredo). *** His children account for San Jose, Flores and Florida, with Salto and Montevideo besides *** - that is the finding of row 120 - *** and until today he existed here only inside other people's notes. *** *** TIER: INDEXED, not image-read. *** Not attached to Sancho's line by anything. *** AND THE PARENT-PAIR QUERY NAMES HIS CHILDREN, 21 September 2026. *** Searching MAURICIO LERENA and CASIMIRA MONTANO as a pair returns twelve Uruguayan records where either name alone returns a crowd. One is explicit: *** CIPRIANO LERENA MONTANA ***, whose 1928 death registration at Flores names both parents, and who is now in this register. *** FOUR MORE ARE CANDIDATES AND ARE NOT ENTERED: *** Manuel Lerena Montana (m. 20 April 1882, San Jose, b.1856), Ignacia Lerena (m. 27 April 1882, Trinidad, b.1864), Clara Lerena de Pallares (d. 3 March 1925, b.1848) and Ignacia Serena Leren de Dolz (d. 12 March 1921, b.1865). *** They match on the pair query but their own entries do not name the parents, *** and this archive does not enter a child on a query shape alone. The dates fit a marriage of 1837.  *** AND A POSSIBLE BROTHER AND SISTER, 9 October 2026. *** If his parents Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzales are the Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez drawn at the apex of the 1858 Trinidad schema, then *** ALEJANDRO LERENA and ANTONINA LERENA of Trinidad are his siblings ***, and his children reaching *** Flores *** are cousins of the whole Trinidad kindred rather than strangers to it. *** STILL NOT MERGED. ***  *** THE ACT IS READ OFF THE PLATE, 9 October 2026, AND THIS ROW'S OWN CAVEAT IS DISCHARGED. *** It carried 'TIER: INDEXED, not image-read' since 21 September. The plate - *** Catedral Basilica San Jose, Religious Marriage Records 1825-1859, image 87 *** - reads: '*** En esta Parroquia de San Jose a tres de Febrero de mil ochocientos treinta y siete... Don MAURICIO LERENA, natural de la VILLA DEL COLLA, hijo legitimo de Don RAMON y de Dona MARIA GONZALEZ, con Dona CASIMIRA MONTANO, natural de esta Villa, hija legitima de Don JOSE y Dona IGNACIA BARREDO ***'. Teniente de cura *** Fray Froylan Mellid ***; certified by *** Jose Joaquin Reyna ***; witnesses *** Don Vicente Muniz *** and *** Dona CLARA LEDENA *** - so written, and *** NOT CLAIMED HERE AS A LERENA *** though the resemblance is obvious. *** HE WAS DEAD BY MARCH 1895 ***, when his granddaughter's birth act calls him fallecido. *** AND A SECOND MAURICIO LERENA EXISTS: *** a man of *** fifty *** - read off the plate - signing as a witness in the First Section of Flores in May 1886. This man married in 1837 and cannot be he. *** NOT ENTERED AS HIS SON: *** an age of fifty in 1886 is a birth about 1836, which is before this marriage, so either the stated age is loose in the ordinary way or the two are not father and son.  *** AND HIS BROTHER'S ACT IS NOW READ TOO, 9 October 2026. *** ALEJANDRO LERENA, *** natural de la VILLA DEL ROSARIO ***, married at the same church twelve years earlier - 16 September 1825 - and his act gives the same parents, *** RAMON LEREÑA and MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ ***. *** TWO BROTHERS, TWO ACTS, ONE PARISH, BOTH BORN IN THE ROSARIO-COLLA DISTRICT. *** *** AND IT SETTLES WHICH SIDE THE TRINIDAD KINDRED HANGS FROM: *** Alejandro's son is BERNABE, his own is CIPRIANO, and the two are first cousins. *** AT TRINIDAD IN 1863: *** a son, Clemencio Lorenzo [as the machine writes it, 'Pemencio Lorenzo'], born 22 November 1863, baptised 9 December, 'hijo legitimo de Macericio Serena y de Casimira Montana'; the couple are godparents again in December 1864. *** HIS BURIAL, 12 NOVEMBER 1879, READ AT THE PLATE, 26 October 2026: *** no. 123, 'Mauricio Lerena': 'hizo entierro de tercera clase y acompano con Cruz alta al cadaver de Don Mauricio Lerena, oriental, casado con Dona Casimira Montana. Fallecio ayer a los setenta y dos anos de edad. Recibio los sacramentos de la Penitencia y Extremauncion', signed Angel Iglesias Santa Maria. *** SO THE MAURICIO WHO MARRIED CASIMIRA MONTANO AT SAN JOSE IN 1837 DIED AT TRINIDAD ON 11 NOVEMBER 1879, married to her at the last. *** Seventy-two is a birth about 1807, earlier than the c.1815 this row carries, and he is the brother who stood godfather in 1825's household of Ramon and Maria Gonzalez; the Mauricio of Trinidad with Petrona Aguilar (1866) and the Mauricio of 1886, 'casado, de cincuenta anos', are NOT this man, who was dead before either date of 1886 and had a wife Casimira, a widow in 1895. *** DEAD BY 1908 - AND HIS WIDOW STILL LIVING, 27 October 2026: *** the civil act on the death of his grandson Juan Cipriano gives the paternal grandparents as 'Mauricio [the machine reads Macario] Lerena, fallecido, y Casimira [Montano], viuda' - agreeing with his burial of 12 November 1879. *** A SON MAURICIO WITH A WIFE BRIGIDA, AND A DAUGHTER IGNACIA, NAMED IN BAPTISMS OF 1882-1884, 29 October 2026: *** grandfather of Mauricio Isidro (1881), Jacinta Margarita (1883) and Robustiana Etelbina (1883), his wife Casimira Montano the grandmother in each. (Machine transcripts, images 28 and 151.)

note: *** Father of Mauricio, and the head of the Rosario-Colla household. *** *** NOT the Ramon LERENA born 1892 in Argentina who is also in this register *** - two different men, and the register now says so on both rows. A standing warning of this archive attaches here: the tree's Gabino of Flores is given as a son of *** Ramon Llerena Cubas and Margarita Leal ***, which may or may not be this Ramon. *** Untested, and deliberately not merged. ***  *** AND A CANDIDATE OF THE FIRST ORDER ARRIVED 9 October 2026. *** The Trinidad expedientes of 1855 and 1858 give the head of the Trinidad kindred as *** RAMON LERENA married to MARIA GONZALEZ ***, with children *** ALEJANDRO *** and *** ANTONINA ***, both *** naturales de SAN JOSE ***. *** THIS ROW IS RAMON LERENA MARRIED TO MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ, NAMED AS MAURICIO'S PARENTS ON A MARRIAGE AT SAN JOSE DE MAYO IN 1837. *** *** SAME COUPLE'S NAMES AND SAME GENERATION. *** If it is one couple, the Trinidad kindred attaches to the Rosario-Colla house and Alejandro and Antonina are Mauricio's siblings. *** NOT MERGED, AND DELIBERATELY SO: *** the 1837 act is INDEXED and not image-read, MARIA GONZALEZ is a common name, and this archive does not join two families on a matching couple alone. *** THE TEST: *** the 1837 San Jose act off the plate, or a baptism of Alejandro, Antonina or Mauricio naming Ramon. See data/trinidad-founding-kindred.tsv. *** AND THE CLAIM OF A SHARED PLACE OF ORIGIN IS WITHDRAWN, 9 October 2026, by the plate that was supposed to confirm it. *** This archive wrote that the 1837 act and the 1858 expediente give the same origin. *** THEY DO NOT. *** The 1837 act, read off the plate, says Mauricio was *** 'natural de la Villa del COLLA' ***; the 1858 expediente says the Trinidad Lerenas are *** 'naturales de SAN JOSE' ***. *** DIFFERENT BIRTHPLACES. *** What is shared is narrower and must be said narrowly: Mauricio was *** MARRIED *** at San Jose de Mayo, and the Trinidad Lerenas were *** BORN *** there. See data/corrections.tsv.  *** AND A SECOND DESCENT LINE REACHED TRINIDAD, 9 October 2026. *** His son Mauricio's son *** CIPRIANO *** is now proved by a birth act to be one of the men fathering Lerena children at *** TRINIDAD *** in the 1870s and 1880s. *** SO TWO OF THOSE TRINIDAD MEN DESCEND FROM A 'RAMON LERENA AND MARIA GONZALEZ' BY TWO INDEPENDENT DOCUMENTS *** - Bernabe through the 1858 kinship schema, Cipriano through the 1837 marriage act and the 1895 birth act. *** THAT IS CONVERGENCE RATHER THAN A NAME MATCH, AND IT IS STILL NOT PROOF: *** two couples can share two names. *** THE TEST NOW: *** a baptism of Alejandro or Antonina at San Jose, or any record naming this Ramon with more than one child.  *** AND THE IDENTIFICATION IS NOT A CANDIDATE AND WAS NEVER ONE - THIS ROW SAID SO ALL MORNING AND WAS WRONG TO. *** data/ramon-lerena-rosario.tsv has held since 17 September that Alejandro and Mauricio are his sons and Bernabe and Cipriano his grandsons. *** AND ON 9 OCTOBER HIS SON'S MARRIAGE ACT WAS READ OFF THE PLATE: *** act No. 17 of *** 16 September 1825 *** at San Jose - '*** desposé... a ALEXANDRO LEREÑA, natural de la VILLA DEL ROSARIO, hijo legitimo de RAMON LEREÑA y de MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ, con MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ, natural de esta Villa, hija legitima de JUAN FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ y de BARBARA SOTURA ***'; godparents *** MARCOS DE LEON GONZALEZ *** and *** MARIA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***. *** THAT IS THE FULL FORM 'MARIA JOSEFA' IN A PRIEST'S HAND, MATCHING THIS ROW'S WIFE EXACTLY. *** *** THE TRANSCRIPT READS 'RAMON PEREÑA'; THE PLATE READS LEREÑA. *** *** A RAMON LERENA HOLDING OFFICE, SIGNING HIS OWN NAME, ON A DATED DAY IN 1800 - found 11 October 2026 inside a Buenos Aires probate file. *** The transcript: *** 'Asi lo proveyo, y firmo Don RAMON LERENA, ALCALDE DE LA SANTA HERMANDAD DEL PARTIDO DEL ROSARIO, a seis dias del mes de Noviembre del ano mil ochocientos. RAMON LERENA. En dicho dia, mes y ano, Yo Don RAMON LERENA, Alcalde de la Santa Hermandad, notifique la providencia antecedente a Dona CELESTINA GONZALEZ en su persona, de que certifico A FALTA DE ESCRIBANO PUBLICO NI REAL, POR NO HABERLO EN ESTA JURISDICCION. RAMON LERENA.' *** *** SO: an ALCALDE DE LA SANTA HERMANDAD - a rural magistrate of the Spanish countryside jurisdiction - of a PARTIDO DEL ROSARIO, acting on 6 NOVEMBER 1800 *** in the estate of *** DON CLEMENTE GARCIA ***, notifying his widow *** DONA CELESTINA GONZALEZ *** about inventories of goods left to a minor. *** AND HE WROTE. *** He signs twice and certifies in his own hand because there was no notary in the district - which is a plain statement about how thinly governed that country was, and a contrast worth drawing with *** SANCHO LLERENA, who nine years earlier could not sign his name. *** *** IS IT THIS MAN? THE DATE FITS EXACTLY AND THE PLACE IS INDICATED BUT NOT PROVED. *** This row has him flourishing c.1800-1820 at *** ROSARIO ***, and the file elsewhere mentions a *** 'vecindad del partido ORIENTAL' ***, which points at the Banda Oriental and so at ROSARIO ORIENTAL in Colonia - this row's own Rosario. *** BUT THERE IS ALSO A PARTIDO DEL ROSARIO ON THE ARGENTINE SIDE ***, the probate was administered at Buenos Aires, which had viceregal jurisdiction over both banks, and *** THE OCR AROUND THE WORD 'ORIENTAL' IS BROKEN *** - the sentence cannot be read whole. *** NOT MERGED INTO THIS ROW AS FACT. *** *** THE TEST IS CHEAP AND NAMED: *** read further in the same file, where an alcalde's jurisdiction is normally stated in full, and check whether the Partido del Rosario it means is the Oriental one. *** 249 images, item 12 of image group #107093472, and only this frame has been read. *** *** THE PLACE IS SETTLED, AND BY THE COURT'S OWN WORDS - 11 October 2026, hours after this row said it was indicated and not proved. *** The providencia that set the whole business going is at image 22, and it addresses *** 'El Alcalde de la Santa Hermandad del PARTIDO DEL ROSARIO, EN LA OTRA BANDA ORIENTAL de este [Rio]' *** - so the Rosario is *** URUGUAYAN ***, not the Argentine Rosario and not Villa del Rosario in Cordoba. *** AND THE WIDOW IS 'VECINA DEL COLLA'. *** This row has called him 'of Rosario-Colla' since the archive's early weeks, on the strength of the 1858 kinship diagram. *** THE COURT PUTS HIM IN EXACTLY THAT PLACE, HOLDING OFFICE THERE, IN 1800. *** *** WHAT HE WAS DOING, across five weeks: *** *** JOSE RIERA, Alcalde Ordinario de Segundo Voto and Juez de Menores of Buenos Aires ***, ordered him to inventory the estate of *** DON CLEMENTE GARCIA *** because the widow *** DONA CELESTINA GONZALEZ *** was *** RESISTING *** it - she had *** 'pasado a segundas nupcias, teniendo hijo menor' ***. On *** 14 October 1800 *** Ramon went to her house with *** JUAN DE URDINARAN *** and *** FRANCISCO PEREZ DE CEBALLOS *** and notified her *** in the presence of her second husband ***; on the 15th he began at 'la nominada Villa del Rosario'; on *** 6 November *** he decreed and signed; on the *** 11th *** he went again with Perez de Ceballos, *** BARTOLOME PARTIA *** and *** ANDRES PAIS ***; and on the *** 12th *** the appraisal continued before *** NICOLAS YRIGOYEN *** as witness. *** THROUGHOUT HE CERTIFIES 'A FALTA DE ESCRIBANO PUBLICO NI REAL, POR NO HABERLO EN ESTA JURISDICCION' *** and signs his own name. *** AN OBSERVATION THAT IS NOT AN ARGUMENT: *** the 1858 diagram puts *** RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ *** at the apex, and the woman at the centre of this file is a *** GONZALEZ of the Colla ***. *** GONZALEZ IS ONE OF THE COMMONEST SURNAMES IN THE RIO DE LA PLATA AND NO CONNECTION IS CLAIMED. *** *** HIS OFFICE GOES BACK FOUR YEARS FURTHER, AND BEFORE IT THERE IS A CAREER - 11 October 2026. *** *** 1796: *** a second probate, that of *** MANUEL CHABO and MARIA MARTA AGAICHU ***, closes *** 'Lo proveyo, mando y firmo D. RAMON LERENA, ALCALDE DE LA SANTA HERMANDAD DEL PARTIDO DEL ROSARIO, a veintiocho dias del mes de OCTUBRE DE MIL SETECIENTOS NOVENTA Y SEIS anos' ***. *** SO HE HELD THE OFFICE AT LEAST 1796-1800, NOT MERELY IN THE ONE YEAR THIS ARCHIVE HAD. *** *** 1794, AND HE IS NOT THE MAGISTRATE YET - THIS IS THE FIND THAT MATTERS. *** In the earlier file on the same estate, the alcalde of the day walks out to *** 'la ESTANCIA del finado Don CLEMENTE GARCIA' *** and there *** 'parecieron ante mi y testigos Don GERONIMO ALONSO y Don RAMON LERENA, SUJETOS NOMBRADOS POR LA VIUDA PARA CONTAR Y TASAR EL GANADO Y CABALLOS de dicha estancia' ***. They were told of the appointment, accepted, *** swore separately *** to do it faithfully, and signed. *** SO IN 1794 HE IS A MAN A WIDOW PICKS TO COUNT HER CATTLE, AND BY 1796 HE IS THE MAGISTRATE OF THE DISTRICT. *** That is the only thing resembling a biography this archive holds for anyone of this family before 1850 - not a birth, a marriage or a death, but *** a trade, a reputation and a rise ***. *** AND IT TELLS US WHAT HE WAS GOOD FOR: *** livestock. A man called in to value cattle and horses on an estancia is a man who knew stock, which is the ordinary competence of the Banda Oriental countryside and the likeliest reason the Santa Hermandad - a rural constabulary - wanted him. *** WHAT HE PRESIDED OVER IN 1796 IS NOT PRETTY, and is recorded because it is the only case of his this archive has read other than the Garcia estate: *** the Chabo petition argues that Maria Marta Agaichu gave her husband a power of attorney without understanding it - *** 'la pobre muchacha criada sin instruccion al lado de sus padres INDIOS GUARANIES, ignorando en todo lo que se le perjudica en el poder que le dio a su marido, TAL VEZ ATEMORIZADA' ***. *** THOSE PEOPLE ARE NOT IN THIS REGISTER AND SHOULD NOT BE *** - he was the official, not a party, which is the boundary written into tools/check-people-named.py the same day. *** A SECOND BAPTISM OF A SON READ AT THE PLATE, 17 October 2026: EUSEBIO CONGENIO, BORN 14 AUGUST 1816 AT THE CORDON. *** The act - 'hijo legitimo de [Ramon] Lerena, natural de MADRID, y de Maria de Leon Gonzalez [...]; abuelos paternos Salvador Lerena y Ana de Cubas; maternos Marcial de Leon Gonzalez y [Isabel ...]; padrino Mauricio de las Mercedes' - gives his birthplace as MADRID where the 1812 La Union act of Manuel Lorenzo has VALDEMORO EN CASTILLA LA NUEVA; the two agree, Valdemoro being a town in that region, and his parents Salvador Lerena and Ana de Cubas are named in both. *** HIS CHILDREN BY THE ACTS READ: *** Manuel Lorenzo (b. 14 November 1812, La Union), Eusebio Congenio (b. 14 August 1816, the Cordon), Luis Manuel (b. 1820, indexed), with Alejandro and Mauricio from their marriage acts. The 1812 and 1816 acts are at Montevideo, so the household moved between Montevideo and the interior in those years - not explained here. *** HIS FIRST MARRIAGE, 16 MAY 1789 - AND HIS BIRTHPLACE TWICE OVER, 26 October 2026. *** The marriage act at Rosario del Colla, read at the plate: 'En la Parroquial de la Villa del Rosario del Colla a 16 dias del mes de Mayo de 1789 yo el Theniente de Cura de ella desposse a Ramon Llerena hijo de Salvador Llerena y de Ana Cubas, naturales todos tres de la Villa de Valdemoro, con Margarita Leal, natural del Tucuman, Obispado de Cordova, viuda de Pedro Cabrera, in facie ecclesiae, sin haver resultado impedimento alguno; fueron testigos Sebastian Gonzalez y Madalena Fuentes del Obispado de Buenos Ayres, de que doy fee', signed Antonio Diaz. So Ramon, son of Salvador Llerena and Ana Cubas, 'natural de Valdemoro' (the act says all three), was at Colla in 1789 and married there a widow from Tucuman, Margarita Leal; the 'natural de Valdemoro' of the baptism of 1812 and the 'natural de Madrid' of 1816 are one man's birthplace in two forms, and Valdemoro is the town. *** THE ROW'S 'UNTESTED' IS TESTED: *** the tree's 'Ramon Llerena Cubas' with a wife Margarita Leal is this Ramon, whose mother was Ana Cubas, and Margarita Leal is a real first wife. [SUPERSEDED 26 October 2026: the sentence above that the tree's Gabino of Flores 'may or may not be this Ramon' and 'untested' - the 1789 act confirms the tree's father and his wife; the tree still names Margarita Leal as Gabino's mother, where Gabino's own death act of 9 February 1890 names Maria Gonzalez, so Margarita is Ramon's first wife and probably not Gabino's mother.] *** TWO WIVES, THEN: Margarita Leal in 1789, Maria Josefa Gonzalez from about 1795-1812. *** His marriage to Maria Josefa Gonzalez is not found; no child of the first marriage is found either.

Settled only by the death act itself, which has not been opened. *** AND THE SAME EVENING THE OTHER END OF IT TURNED UP. *** The 1896 death gives his spouse as *** MANUELA LEMOS *** - and this register entered a Manuela LEMOS on 11 October, wife of an unidentified 'Pedro A. LERENA', with children Felicia Clementina (b. c.1868) and Manuel Antonio (b. 31 March 1883), under an explicit note that *** which Pedro she married was not settled. *** *** Two questions asked from opposite ends meet on one record. *** And the age: a man born 1827 fathers a child in 1883 at fifty-six, one born 1817 at sixty-six - so the death record's estimate fits the children better than the census one, which is the reverse of how this row weighted them earlier today. *** Opening the 1896 death act is now the cheapest thing that would attach a whole Montevideo line to this archive's trunk. *** *** AND THE ACT WAS OPENED THE SAME EVENING. *** Acta 353: he died at five in the afternoon of 6 November 1896 at calle Rivera No. 163, of tisis pulmonar, certified by Dr Vitale, before Vicente Carricaonde, Juez de Paz of the 15th section. The act reads: *** 'nacido en Montevideo', 'de sesenta y nueve anos de edad', 'hijo legitimo de Don PEDRO A. LERENA, oriental, fallecido, y de Dona VICENTA DE LA VEGA, oriental, fallecida'. *** His wife is named as Dona Manuela, oriental, 53, and the children as *** Antonio, Carlos Teodoro and Manuel Antonio ***, with the first declarant - Don Pedro A. Lerena, soltero, empleado - declared to be the dead man's son. *** SO THE ATTACHMENT IS NO LONGER A CANDIDATE: the act names his parents. *** What is now in doubt is the CENSUS DATE. Sixty-nine in 1896 means born about 1827, and a man born in 1827 is six in 1833, not sixteen - he is sixteen in 1843. *** Either household 229 is later than this archive dates it, or the sixteen-year-old is a different son of the same couple. *** *** THE CENSUS IS THE PADRON OF 1850, NOT c.1833 - CORRECTED 12 OCTOBER 2026. *** The catalogue lists film 7499042 item by item: item 1 is libro 263, 1843; *** item 2, where this household sits, is LIBRO 264, 1850. *** *** So this birth year moved seventeen years later. *** And the head of the household, entered at forty, was born about 1810 - *** not the Pedro Antonio Lerena born 31 July 1793 whom this archive had read him as. *** Either the census age is badly wrong or the household belongs to a different Pedro A. Lerena married to a different Vicenta Vega; under the neighbouring book, 1843, he would still be born about 1803 and still not be the man of 1793. See data/corrections.tsv. His burial is entered at the Cordon on 8 November 1896: 'Pedro Lerena [the transcript has Lorena], de sesenta y nueve anos, casado con Manuela Lemos [Loma], orientales. Fallecio ayer.' Name, age and wife agree with the civil act. The burial says 'ayer' on the 8th and the civil act says he died on the 6th, so the 'ayer' is not a date. *** HIS BAPTISM IS FOUND AND READ AT THE PLATE, 17 October 2026, AND IT SETTLES HIS BIRTH YEAR: BORN 1 DECEMBER 1828. *** 'En doze de Diciembre del ano de mil ochocientos veinte y ocho yo D. Benito Alonso Covian Teniente Cura en esta Vice Parroquia de Nra Sra del Carmen la Mayor en el Cordon extramuros de Monte Video bautice solemnemente a Pedro Antonio Natalio, que nacio el dia primero del corriente, hijo [legitimo] de Dn Pedro Antonio Llerena, natural de Canelones, y de Da Vicenta Vega, natural de Monte Video. Fueron padrinos Ygnacio Perez y Gregoria Silba.' The margin reads 'Pedro Antonio Natalio Llerena, Parvulo'. *** HIS CENSUS AGE OF 16 IN 1850 WAS SIX YEARS LATE (it gave c.1834), and the 'c.1817' of an earlier reading was eleven years early; the age at death, 69 in 1896, would give 1827 - one year off. *** *** HIS FULL NAME IS PEDRO ANTONIO NATALIO, *** and that briefly made him a candidate for the 'Pedro Antonio Lerena' who was Teresa Leonar's husband. *** HE IS NOT: *** the 1864 christening of Teresa's daughter Manuela names her husband's parents as Pedro and Maria Pereyra, and this man's mother was Vicenta Vega. His own baptism names no grandparents. *** A THIRD CANDIDATE FOR THE CORDON FATHER OF 1862-63, 18 October 2026: *** a 'D. Pedro A. Lerena' with a wife 'Da. Trinidad Morales, orientales' baptised a daughter Amelia (born 2 May 1862) at the Cordon on 8 February 1863. He cannot be Teresa Leonard's husband (the dispensation of June 1861 and the christening of their daughter in 1864 have him with Teresa), and may be THIS man - 'Pedro A.', baptised at the Cordon in 1828, with a first wife Trinidad Morales before Manuela Lemos - but no act says whose son he is, so he is entered apart and NOT MERGED.

name: Carlos LERENA (of Mendoza, m. Adela CAMIGLIA)
source: Argentina, Mendoza, Catholic Church Records - baptism of Avelino Carlos Lerena, San Nicolas de Tolentino, 12 Mar 1904, naming the parents; and Santiago Apostol y San Nicolas (Iglesia Matriz de Mendoza), Baptism Records 1899-1901 - baptism of 6 January 1900; DGS film 004597291 image 69, waypoint Q633-3DR, ark 3:1:939X-HF9M-7S - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Santiago Apostol y San Nicolas (Iglesia Matriz de Mendoza), Baptism Records 1901-1903 - printed-form baptism of 23 April 1902; DGS film 004597291 item 003 image 95, ark 3:1:939X-HFTB-Z - PLATE READ 9 October 2026
note: *** A SECOND CARLOS LERENA, AND THE REGISTER HAS SAID SO SINCE 14 SEPTEMBER WITHOUT GIVING HIM A ROW. *** He is named with *** ADELA CAMIGLIA *** as the parents of AVELINO CARLOS LERENA, baptised at San Nicolas de Tolentino, Mendoza, on 12 March 1904. *** HE IS NOT CARLOS AUGUSTO FEDERICO LERENA SALVANACH, *** the son of Gilberto who married Rosa Maria Eppens at Retiro in 1914: that act calls its groom *** SOLTERO *** at thirty, and Mendoza is a long way from Buenos Aires. The distinction was made on the Eppens row - "two men, one name" - but the relationship file went on attaching Adela and Avelino to the wrong man until the two rows were merged on 20 September and the disagreement became visible. *** NOTHING IS KNOWN OF HIM BEYOND THE ACT *** - not a birth, not a marriage, not a place of origin. *** HE IS ORIENTAL - URUGUAYAN - AND THAT ANSWERS ONE OF THE FOUR OPEN QUESTIONS ON /open-questions/, 9 October 2026. *** The baptism of his daughter *** MARIA ADELA *** at the Iglesia Matriz de Mendoza on 6 January 1900 calls the parents '*** orientales, domiciliados en este Curato ***'. data/cajon-985-origins.tsv had his origin as 'Not established'. *** SO FOUR OF THE CAJON 985 FATHERS ARE NOW TRACEABLE AND EVERY ONE IS URUGUAYAN OR MARRIED IN URUGUAY ***, which is a base rate that bears on Juan Carlos Lerena without naming him. *** AND AN AVELINO LERENA STOOD GODFATHER TO HIS DAUGHTER, BY PROXY: *** 'padrinos Domingo Simois *** por ABELINO LERENA ***'. This register holds *** FOUR *** men of that name and the act gives him no age, no patronymic and no residence - *** SO HE IS NOT PLACED IN ANY BRANCH, AND THE REASON IS ON THE RECORD: *** the Arturo Lerena row of that same file was once written as a son of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel and withdrawn the same day as a conflation. *** THE NAME OF HIS WIFE IS ALSO WRONG IN THIS ROW'S TITLE: *** the act and the army index both write *** CARNIGLIA ***, with an r. *** AND THE CITY, AN HOUR AFTER THE COUNTRY. *** His second daughter's baptism of 23 April 1902 is on a PRINTED FORM - 'Partidas de Bautismos de la Parroquia Matriz de Mendoza' - with a *** 'natural de' blank for each parent ***, and it reads '*** Hija legitima de D. CARLOS LERENA, natural de MONTEVIDEO ***'. *** THE 1900 ACT COULD ONLY SAY 'ORIENTALES' BECAUSE IT WAS PROSE; THE 1902 FORM ASKS THE QUESTION. *** *** SO HE IS A MONTEVIDEAN IN MENDOZA ***, and the fourth traceable father of Cajon 985 - none of whom is Argentine. *** AND A SECOND LERENA STOOD GODPARENT TO A CHILD OF HIS, AGAIN BY PROXY: *** *** MERCEDES LERENA DE MARTINEZ ***, represented by the child's own mother. *** TWO LERENA GODPARENTS, NEITHER PRESENT - which is what relatives in another country do. ***

name: Avelino Eduardo LERENA Traibel
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening of Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre, Union, Montevideo, 5 Mar 1866, ark 1:1:6D7Z-JGH2; and of Pedro Gualberto, Cordon, Montevideo, 15 Jan 1870; index read 20 September 2026; and named as GODFATHER at the Iglesia Matriz christening of Angelica Maria Lerena Villademoros, 29 September 1872 - ark 1:1:6DFQ-YF26 - IMAGE READ 27 September 2026; film 004298263 image 03147; and Uruguay, Civil Registration - Montevideo, 4a seccion, MARRIAGE act No. 83 of 20 November 1897, folio 42, expediente No. 94 - *** PLATE READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N35B-M; index ark 1:1:XS6K-MYFD; volume 'Montevideo. Marriage Records 1896-1897, 1900, 1898-1899'
note: *** A FORK THIS ARCHIVE REFUSED TO CHOOSE IS NOW DECIDED, 20 September 2026. *** On 16 September a working log found a branch indexed *** LERENA VILLADEMOROS *** and set out two readings without picking one: either *** Avelino Lerena Fernandez (b.1815) married twice ***, Ambrosia Traibel and then Celedonia Villademoros, *** or Avelino Eduardo is a SON of his. *** It is the son. Two separate parish acts give this man's own father as *** AVELINO SERENA/LERENA *** with *** AMBROSIA TRAIBEL *** named on the record - so he is a child of that marriage, and the Villademoros children are Sancho's great-grandchildren. *** HE IS THEREFORE A NEW CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, *** beside Alejandro, Josefa, Ana Rosario, Alfredo Justiniano and Mercedes. He married *** CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***, daughter of Pedro Villademoros and Angelica Mendez. *** INDEX-LEVEL: *** both acts are machine-indexed and neither image has been opened here. *** AND THE TEST NAMED ABOVE WAS RUN THE SAME EVENING AND CAME BACK EMPTY. *** LERENA with spouse surname VILLADEMOROS, Uruguay: 6,352 records, and *** not one of them is a marriage act. *** Every hit is a parent entry on somebody else's baptism or civil registration. *** The control is the one that worked two hours earlier: *** the same query shape on LERENA with spouse JUANICO puts the marriage act of 19 December 1864 at RANK ONE. So the shape finds a marriage when there is one to find. *** NEITHER VILLADEMOROS MARRIAGE IS IN THE INDEXED RECORD, *** and the brothers-and-sisters reading stays an inference. It would be settled by the parish marriage books of the Cordon and Union, which have not been walked.  *** AND HE HAS MORE CHILDREN THAN THIS ARCHIVE COULD SEE, FOUND 21 September 2026 BY DELETING A SEARCH PARAMETER. *** A parent-pair query on him with CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS returns *** ZERO ***. Dropping the mother's SURNAME and keeping only 'Celedonia' returns *** SEVEN *** - including the two christenings this archive already held, which is how the zero was known to be false. The seven add: *** PEDRO SEGUNDO LERENA VILLADEMOROS, who died at Montevideo on 23 August 1936 aged 66, certificate 150, married to PAULINA PRANDO ALGAR ***; *** an AVELINO LERENA who died at Montevideo on 5 January 1914 aged 45, certificate 9, married to CARMEN LORENTE ***, whose mother is written CELEDONIA VILLADEMORO without the s; and marriage registrations of 1921 for both Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre and Pedro Gualberto. *** WHETHER THAT IS FOUR CHILDREN OR TWO IS NOT SETTLED AND IS NOT GUESSED HERE. *** Pedro Segundo's estimated 1870 sits on Pedro Gualberto's birth of 19 October 1869; the 1914 Avelino's estimated 1869 sits four years off Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre's December 1865 - and a man who died in 1914 cannot register a marriage in 1921. *** The ages come from death certificates and are the weakest field there is. *** TEST: the two 1921 marriage registrations, which would show which of these men were alive to marry. *** HE IS ARGENTINO ON THE PLATE, 27 September 2026, and that is new. *** The Iglesia Matriz act of 29 September 1872 calls him 'AVELINO LERENA, *** argentino ***' and his wife 'CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, *** argentina ***'. *** AND IT NAMES HIS PARENTS: 'Abuelos paternos AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL' *** - so his descent from Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel is on a parish act and no longer rests on the index alone. A THIRD CHILD is added from it: Angelica Maria, born 8 April 1872. *** HE HAS A DEATH AT LAST, AND IT IS IN CANELONES - 11 October 2026. *** His daughter Angelica's marriage act of 20 November 1897 describes him as *** 'Don AVELINO, ORIENTAL, FALLECIDO EN CANELONES EN EL ANO DE 1895' *** - and his widow Celedonia is party to the same act, so the statement is hers. *** SO HE DIED IN 1895, IN THE DEPARTMENT OF CANELONES ***, not at Montevideo where this archive has always had the family. *** AND IT BEARS ON A READING THIS ARCHIVE WITHDREW, WITHOUT REVIVING IT. *** On 22 September the claim that *** AVELINO LERENA FERNANDEZ *** - his FATHER - died at “La Paz, Canelones” was withdrawn, because the father died at Montevideo on 22 August 1890. *** THAT RETRACTION STANDS. *** But the secondary tree file it came from now looks less like invention and more like *** A CONFUSION OF FATHER WITH SON ***: there IS an Avelino Lerena who died in Canelones, and it is this one. *** THE PRECISE PLACE WITHIN CANELONES IS NOT STATED HERE *** and nothing in this act says La Paz. *** THE NEXT RECORD TO FIND IS HIS OWN DEATH ACT, Canelones, 1895. ***

name: Celedonia VILLADEMOROS (wife of Avelino Eduardo)

Marriage Records 1896-1897, 1900, 1898-1899'; and Nuestra Senora del Carmen La Mayor, Cordon, Montevideo - RELIGIOUS MARRIAGE of 28 December 1871 - *** FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-B3DF-C, volume 'Religious Marriage Records January 1866-May 1872'
note: Wife of *** AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL ***, and daughter of *** PEDRO VILLADEMOROS and ANGELICA MENDEZ ***. Mother of Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre (b. December 1865), Pedro Gualberto (b. 19 October 1869) and, on civil registration indexes, Pedro Segundo and Angelica Maria. *** The surname is a notable Uruguayan one and no claim is made about that here. *** Index-level. *** ARGENTINA, on the Iglesia Matriz act of 29 September 1872 ***, where her daughter Angelica Maria is baptised and her own parents are named as *** PEDRO and ANGELICA MENDEZ ***. Her sister or kinswoman ELISA VILLADEMOROS stood godmother, with ALEJANDRO M. LERENA. *** A WIDOW BY 1897, AND AN AGE. *** Her daughter Angelica's marriage act of 20 November 1897 gives *** 'Dona CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, de 55 anos, de estado VIUDA, de profesion labores de su sexo, de nacionalidad ARGENTINA, domiciliada en esta Ciudad' *** - so born about *** 1842 ***, *** ARGENTINE *** as the 1872 baptism also says, and *** WIDOWED *** by her husband's death in Canelones in 1895. She was living at Montevideo in 1897. *** HER NAME IS SPELLED IN FULL AND CORRECTLY ON THIS ACT ***, which is worth saying of an index that turned her husband into 'Arabia Larena Lerena' and 'Ardino Serena'. *** HER SISTER'S MARRIAGE ACT PROVES THE SISTERHOOD, 11 October 2026. *** The Cordon act of 28 December 1871 makes *** ELISA VILLADEMOROS *** the daughter of *** the late D. PEDRO and Dona ANGELICA VILLADEMOROS ***, which is this row's own couple. *** SO ELISA IS HER SISTER AND ALEJANDRO MAXIMO LERENA IS HER BROTHER-IN-LAW TWICE OVER *** - he is also her husband's brother. *** AND IT ESTABLISHES A PATTERN THIS ARCHIVE HAS NOW SEEN TWICE IN ONE DAY: TWO BROTHERS MARRIED TWO SISTERS. *** *** ALEJANDRO MAXIMO LERENA *** and *** AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL *** are both sons of *** AVELINO LERENA FERNANDEZ and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***; *** ELISA *** and *** CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS *** are both daughters of *** PEDRO VILLADEMOROS and ANGELICA ***. *** SO THE LERENA VILLADEMOROS COUSINS ARE DOUBLE FIRST COUSINS *** - exactly the structure that forced a dispensation at Trinidad in 1911, here produced in Montevideo a generation earlier. *** NO DISPENSATION OF KINSHIP WAS NEEDED FOR THE MARRIAGES THEMSELVES ***, because the two families were not related before them; what was dispensed in 1871 was *** TWO CONCILIAR BANNS ***, a dispensation of notice and not of blood.

source: Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - birth act N 424, Montevideo, 6 November 1886; ark 1:1:VR4Z-DDT - IMAGE READ 22 September 2026; film 004596830 image 01806; and Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - birth act Num 108, Montevideo, March 1888; ark 1:1:VR4Z-VVB - IMAGE READ 22 September 2026; film 004596830 image 02145
note: Mother of Hector Narciso (1886) and Emilia Alberta (1888), both born at her own address, *** calle Ybirini N 321, Montevideo ***, while Alejandro M. Lerena was living at calle San Jose N 17. She is *** soltera *** on both acts and he is *** viudo ***, so the children are registered as hijos de los declarantes and no marriage is stated. *** HER NATIONALITY IS GIVEN TWO DIFFERENT WAYS, IN FRONT OF HER, SIXTEEN MONTHS APART: "italiana" in 1886 and "austriaca" in 1888. *** Aged 22 and then 24, which is consistent. The Austrian Empire held Italian-speaking lands until 1918, so a Trieste or Trentino subject could truthfully be described either way and the two need not conflict - but they are not the same claim and this archive records both rather than picking. Indexed elsewhere as Basani, Bossani, Barsani and Balani.

name: Hector Narciso LERENA Bassani
source: Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - birth act N 424, Montevideo, 6 November 1886; ark 1:1:VR4Z-DDT - IMAGE READ 22 September 2026; film 004596830 image 01806; and Argentina, Capital Federal, registros parroquiales 1640-1978 - marriage act 491, San Carlos, Buenos Aires, 25 February 1911; ark 1:1:XS67-ZFL2 - IMAGE READ 22 September 2026; film 004571398 image 00420; and daughter Emilia Cecilia b. 20 Dec 1915, Capital Federal
note: Born *** 29 October 1886 *** and registered at Montevideo on 6 November, act N 424, page 14. Son of Alejandro M. Lerena and Julia Bassani, "hijo de los declarantes". *** HE IS THE EVIDENCE THAT THIS FAMILY WAS IN MONTEVIDEO BEFORE IT WAS IN BUENOS AIRES *** - the Argentine records for these parents begin with a baptism in 1905, nineteen years later. Appears again in Argentine military records 1911-1936 and in Capital Federal parish records, both attached in the FamilySearch tree to the same man, L8GL-F8B. *** MERGED 22 SEPTEMBER 2026 WITH THE ROW THAT STOOD HERE AS "Hector LERENA" *** - an Argentine of Buenos Aires who married AMALIA PACHECO and had a daughter Emilia Cecilia on 20 December 1915. They are one man, and the merge is made on the ACT and not on the tree's attachment. The San Carlos marriage of 25 February 1911 was opened: "hijo legitimo de D. *** ALEJANDRO MAXIMO *** [Lerena] ... y de dona *** JULIA BA[SSANI] ***, natural de Italia ... con dona *** AMALIA PA[CHECO] ***". *** THREE THINGS AGREE AT ONCE - the wife the old row carried, the parents this row carries, and the age. *** He is "de la Rep. Oriental, de veinte y cuatro" on 25 February 1911, which puts his birth between 26 February 1886 and 25 February 1887 and fits 29 October 1886 exactly. *** AND IT CORRECTS THE INDEX, WHICH HAS HIM BORN 1887 AT ALMAGRO, BUENOS AIRES. *** The act says ORIENTAL. The indexer defaulted the birthplace to the event place, which is a thing this collection's index does. His trade on the act is *** dibujante ***, draughtsman, and he lived at calle Gurruchaga 1388. *** HE IS ALSO "hijo LEGITIMO" IN 1911, THOUGH HIS MONTEVIDEO BIRTH ACT OF 1886 RECORDS NO MARRIAGE *** - his father was a widower and his mother soltera. Either Alejandro and Julia married between 1888 and 1911, or the parish wrote the ordinary word. This archive does not know which, and the marriage of those two has not been found.

name: Angelica Maria LERENA Villademoros
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening of Angelica Maria, Iglesia Matriz (Basilica Metropolitana), Montevideo, 29 September 1872, libro 7 de Bautismos folio 918; ark 1:1:6DFQ-YF26 - IMAGE READ 27 September 2026; film 004298263 image 03147; and Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - indexed as a child of Celedonia Villademoros under her MARRIED name; index read 27 September 2026; and Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - death registration of 'Eduardo Zalduando Pou', Montevideo, 22 August 1913, aged 52, certificate 553, index ark 1:1:6LXZ-JV32, DGS 008165206 image 283 (PLATE NOT OPENED - the viewer demanded a sign-in on 11 October 2026); with index arks 1:1:6NFW-X112 and 1:1:6Y2Q-1WZB for the two children; and Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - marriage of 'Eduardo Zalduando' and Maria Ester Costa at La Paz in Canelones, 20 December 1927, certificate 30, index ark 1:1:X92R-F5N1, DGS 008166595 image 207 - indexes read 10-11 October 2026; and San Juan Bautista, Pocitos, Montevideo - baptism of Maria Margarita Luisa, 15 August 1903, folio 344 - *** PLATE RE-READ AT FULL RESOLUTION 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; film 007713400 image 02828; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R346-Z; and Uruguay, Civil Registration - Montevideo, death act No. 553 of Eduardo Zalduondo, 22 August 1913 - *** PLATE READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; DGS 008165206 image 283; ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-2DNF; index ark 1:1:6LXZ-JV32; and Uruguay, Civil Registration - Montevideo, 4a seccion, MARRIAGE act No. 83 of 20 November 1897, folio 42, expediente No. 94 - *** PLATE READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N35B-M; index ark 1:1:XS6K-MYFD; volume 'Montevideo. Marriage Records 1896-1897, 1900, 1898-1899'
note: *** A THIRD CHILD OF AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL AND CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, new to this archive 27 September 2026. *** Born *** 8 April 1872 *** and baptised at the *** Iglesia Matriz *** on 29 September 1872, between Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre (1866) and the family's later record. The act reads: 'bautizo solemnemente en ella a ANGELICA MARIA, que nacio el ocho de Abril del presente ano, hija legitima de AVELINO LERENA, argentino, y CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, argentina. Abuelos paternos AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, abuelos maternos PEDRO y ANGELICA MENDEZ. Fueron padrinos ALEJANDRO M. LERENA y ELISA VILLADEMOROS, a quienes instruyo.' *** THE INDEX DATES THIS ACT 1919 AND IT IS 1872 - FORTY-SEVEN YEARS OUT. *** What the indexer read is the CERTIFICATE: 'expido la presente ... en Montevideo a veintiocho de Septiembre de mil novecientos diez y nueve', signed Ramon Howard at the Basilica Metropolitana. This archive already had the rule for that - a certified copy carries two dates and the index takes the wrong one - and this is the largest gap it has yet produced. *** SHE MARRIED A ZALDUANDO, found 27 September 2026 the same day she was entered here. *** The Uruguayan civil index carries her as *** 'ANGELICA LERMA DE ZALDUANDO' ***, daughter of Celedonia Villademoros and a father the machine renders 'Arabia Larena Lerena' - which is AVELINO LERENA. *** INDEX ONLY: no image opened, and 'Lerma' is the index's word, not a record's. *** The marriage itself has not been found and is the next thing to look for. *** HER HUSBAND MAY ALREADY HAVE BEEN IN THIS REGISTER ALL ALONG, UNDER ANOTHER SURNAME - 11 October 2026. *** Row 186 asked who the 'Zalduando' of her married name was. The civil register gives him as *** 'EDUARDO ZALDUANDO POU' ***, dead at *** Montevideo on 22 August 1913 *** aged *** fifty-two *** (born about *** 1861 ***), certificate 553, son of *** JUAN *** and *** DOLORES POU ***; so she was *** WIDOWED AT FORTY-ONE ***. It names two children: *** EDUARDO AVELINO ***, born about 1901 at La Paz in Canelones, who married Maria Ester Costa there in 1927, and *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA ***. *** AND ON 11 OCTOBER 2026 THE DUPLICATES GATE CAUGHT SOMETHING MUCH LARGER THAN A DUPLICATE. *** Four index entries had been worked up as a NEW family - an 'Eduardo ZALDUONDO Pou' with parents Juan and Dolores Pou, married to a Lerena, with a daughter Maria Margarita. Every one of those people was *** ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER UNDER ZALDUONDO ***, off the 1903 Pocitos plate. Set side by side the agreement is fourfold: *** the husband EDUARDO; his father JUAN; his mother DOLORES POU; and a daughter MARIA MARGARITA *** - with the wife a Lerena daughter of *** AVELINO *** and *** CELEDONIA/CELIDONIA *** in both. Two unrelated Montevideo households do not match on all five. *** SO IT IS ONE HOUSEHOLD, AND ONE OF THE TWO SURNAME READINGS IS WRONG. *** The 1903 reading is from a PLATE; the 1913 reading is from an INDEX, and it is the same index that renders Lerena as 'Lerma' and Avelino Lerena as 'Arabia Larena Lerena'. *** A PLATE OUTRANKS AN INDEX, so ZALDUONDO is the better reading and 'Zalduando' is most likely its mangling *** - which also explains why the 1903 machine transcript called him *** 'DEL SUANDO' ***, a string far closer to 'Zalduando' than to what the plate says. *** NOT MERGED YET, AND DELIBERATELY SO. *** The test is one plate: *** DGS 008165206 IMAGE 283 ***, the 1913 death act, which gives the surname and the parents in the register's own hand and should name the widow. It was attempted on 11 October 2026 and the image viewer *** REDIRECTED TO A SIGN-IN *** - false-zero disguise seventeen, which this archive has met before. *** WHAT THIS MEANS FOR HER SPECIFICALLY: *** the 1903 Pocitos plate gives that same Eduardo's wife as *** AMELIA *** Lerena, not Angelica. Either *** SHE AND AMELIA ARE ONE WOMAN *** under two readings of one forename, or *** AMELIA IS A SISTER *** and the 1913 index has put the wrong sister's name on the act. *** SHE IS NOT MERGED WITH AMELIA. *** *** AND A SEPARATE CAUTION, EARNED THE HARD WAY: *** the first draft of this work was written onto *** MARIA ANGELICA JULIA LERENA SALVANACH, born 1886 *** - the same four names in a different order - by a prefix match on 'Maria Angelica'. The chronology caught it: that woman would have been fifteen when this couple's eldest was born. *** NAME ORDER IS NOT IDENTITY. *** *** Her death year is given as 1952 by the FamilySearch tree *** (profile GBST-SC4), which is SECONDARY and is recorded here as a lead, not a fact. *** HER OWN MARRIAGE IS STILL NOT FOUND. *** *** BOTH PLATES WERE READ ON 11 OCTOBER 2026 AND THEY SETTLE THE HOUSEHOLD AND OVERTURN WHAT THIS ARCHIVE SAID ABOUT IT THAT MORNING. *** The surname is *** ZALDUONDO ***, not Zalsamendi: the 1903 act heads its entry 'Maria Zalduondo' and names the father 'Eduardo Zalduondo', and the 1913 act says 'ha fallecido Eduardo Zalduando ... era hijo de Juan Zalduondo y de Dolores Pou, fallecidos'. *** ZALSAMENDI WAS A MISREADING AND IT STOOD THREE WEEKS. ***  *** AMELIA LERENA IS THIS WOMAN, AND THE ROW THAT HELD HER SEPARATELY SINCE 14 SEPTEMBER IS MERGED HERE. *** The 1903 Pocitos act makes *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA *** the daughter of Eduardo Zalduondo and *** 'AMELIA LERENA' ***, with maternal grandparents *** 'AVELINO y CELIDONIA B. de LERENA' ***. The 1913 act makes the same Maria Margarita one of *** THREE CHILDREN OF HIS UNION WITH 'ANGELICA LERENA' ***. *** ONE CHILD CANNOT BE INSIDE TWO DIFFERENT UNIONS, SO THE TWO NAMES ARE ONE WOMAN *** - the alternative, that he married two sisters, is refused by the 1913 act placing Maria Margarita inside the Angelica union. *** HER PARENTS SETTLE WHICH WOMAN: *** 'Avelino y Celidonia B. de Lerena' is AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL and CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, this row's own parents. *** THE FORENAME CONFLICT IS NOT EXPLAINED AWAY, ONLY OUTVOTED: *** her 1872 baptism says ANGELICA MARIA and the 1913 act says ANGELICA; only the 1903 priest wrote AMELIA, clearly and at high magnification. *** 'AMELIA' IS KEPT AS A RECORDED VARIANT, NOT ERASED. ***  *** HER HUSBAND, FROM HIS OWN DEATH ACT: *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO, *** born at MONTEVIDEO *** about 1861, *** JUBILADO *** (retired) by fifty-two, died *** 22 August 1913 at calle Juan B. Blanco 9 *** of *** angina de pecho ***, certified by Dr Bordoni Posse, son of *** JUAN ZALDUONDO *** and *** DOLORES POU ***, *** BOTH ALREADY DEAD BY 1913 ***. So she was *** WIDOWED AT FORTY-ONE ***. The act, read from the image: *** 'En Montevideo, el dia veinte y dos de Agosto de mil novecientos trece, a las tres de la tarde, por ante mi, EDUARDO J. MORATORIO, Juez de Paz de la 18a seccion del Departamento de la Capital y Oficial del Estado Civil, comparecieron Don AGUSTIN AGNESE, de veinte y ocho anos, soltero, oriental, empleado, y Don CONRADO P. ABAL, de veinte y dos anos, soltero, oriental, empleado, vecino de la calle Colonia 1967; declarando que a las siete de la manana del dia de hoy, y en la calle JUAN B. BLANCO 9, ha fallecido EDUARDO ZALDUANDO, del sexo masculino, de nacionalidad oriental, NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO, de cincuenta y dos anos de edad, de estado casado y de profesion JUBILADO, a consecuencia de ANGINA DE PECHO, segun consta del certificado del Dr. BORDONI POSSE. Que el finado era hijo de JUAN ZALDUONDO y de DOLORES POU, FALLECIDOS. Asi mismo se hace constar que era casado con ANGELICA LERENA, de cuya union quedan TRES HIJOS llamados: MARIA ELENA, EDUARDO AVELINO y MARIA MARGARITA.' *** *** AND THERE ARE THREE CHILDREN, NOT TWO: *** *** MARIA ELENA ***, *** EDUARDO AVELINO *** and *** MARIA MARGARITA [LUISA] ***. Maria Elena is new to this archive and nothing else is known of her. *** HER OWN MARRIAGE ACT IS STILL NOT FOUND. *** *** HER MARRIAGE IS FOUND, 11 OCTOBER 2026 - THE SAME DAY THE QUESTION WAS ASKED. *** She married *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO *** by civil act at *** Montevideo, 4th section, at five in the afternoon on 20 NOVEMBER 1897 ***, act *** No. 83 ***, folio 42, before the Juez de Paz *** GALLO PAREJA ***, the marriage itself recorded in expediente No. 94. *** SHE WAS LIVING AT PLAZA LIBERTAD No. 9 *** and he with his parents at calle Convencion No. 226. *** SHE SIGNED THE ACT HERSELF, 'Angelica Lerena' *** - her own hand, her own spelling, against an index that renders her 'Lerma', 'Zerena' and 'Lorena'. *** THE WITNESSES WERE NOT STRANGERS: *** *** FERNANDO MORATORIO ***, fifty, married, of commerce, of calle Uruguay 97 - *** almost certainly her UNCLE BY MARRIAGE ***, the husband of Josefa Lerena Traibel, her father's sister - and *** AGUSTIN RIVA ***, thirty-eight, married, empleado, of calle Sarandi 166. *** AND A DATE THAT ALMOST MATCHES: the act says she was born EIGHT APRIL 1871; her baptism says EIGHT APRIL 1872. *** *** SAME DAY, SAME MONTH, ONE YEAR APART. *** The day and month are what identify her and they agree exactly; the year is recorded here as a conflict rather than resolved, since a stated age or year on a marriage act is the party's own account. *** NO CHILDREN WERE LEGITIMISED: *** the act's 'Legitiman' line is *** BLANK ***, so all three children were born after November 1897.

name: Dona Angelica VILLADEMOROS (godmother 1873)
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening of Alejandro Joaquin Narciso Lerena, Cordon, Montevideo, 29 May 1873; ark 1:1:6D3Z-WTXR - IMAGE READ 27 September 2026; film 007713388 image 02091; and Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - indexed as spouse of Joaquin Requena; index read 27 September 2026; and Nuestra Senora del Carmen La Mayor, Cordon, Montevideo - RELIGIOUS MARRIAGE of 28 December 1871 - *** FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-B3DF-C, volume 'Religious Marriage Records January 1866-May 1872'
note: Godmother at the Cordon christening of *** Alejandro Joaquin Narciso Lerena *** on 29 May 1873, with Don Joaquin Regusa. *** A THIRD VILLADEMOROS WOMAN, and the three of them make the sisterhood this archive had only guessed at much harder to doubt: *** CELEDONIA married Avelino Eduardo Lerena Traibel, ELISA is named beside Alejandro M. Lerena, and ANGELICA stands at the font for Elisa's son. Three Villademoros women inside one Lerena family in two years. *** AND THE GODFATHER'S SURNAME IS REQUENA, NOT REGUSA, 27 September 2026. *** The 1873 Cordon index reads the godfather 'Joaquin REGUSA y Garcia'. The Uruguayan civil index carries *** ANGELICA VILLADEMOROS married to JOAQUIN REQUENA ***, with a daughter Mercedes Requena Villademoros Garcia - and a Requena y Garcia appears again in 1949. *** So the 1873 godparents were a married couple ***, which is the ordinary choice and was invisible while the surname was misread. *** AND SHE IS NOW RULED OUT AS THE MOTHER, 11 October 2026 - which is what this row needed. *** Elisa's marriage act of 28 December 1871 calls her parents *** 'los finados D. PEDRO y Dona ANGELICA VILLADEMOROS' *** - both *** DEAD by that date ***. *** A WOMAN DEAD IN 1871 CANNOT STAND AT A FONT IN 1873 ***, so this Angelica is a daughter of that couple and a sister of Elisa and Celedonia, exactly as this row reasoned from three women appearing inside one family. *** THE REASONING WAS RIGHT AND IS NOW ANCHORED ON A DOCUMENT. ***

name: Jacinta Mercedes Gregoria LERENA Villademoros
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening of Jacinta Mercedes Gregoria, Cordon, Montevideo, 26 December 1877; ark 1:1:6D3Z-WP5Z - IMAGE READ 27 September 2026; film 007713388 image 02455; and Basilica San Jose de Flores, Buenos Aires City. Baptism Records 1917-1918 - acta No. 446 of 20 January 1918; image 244, ark 3:1:939D-G69G-M3 - FULL-TEXT read 10 October 2026
note: *** THE CHILD WHOSE BAPTISM ANSWERED THE ARCHIVE'S OLDEST OPEN QUESTION. *** Born *** 19 September 1876 *** and baptised at the Cordon on 26 December 1877, fifteen months later - and the delay is the point, because her mother had died in between. The act reads: 'El P. D. JOSE BALBI bautizo a JACINTA MERCEDES GREGORIA, nacida el 19 de Sept. ultimo, hija legitima de D. *** ALEJANDRO M. LERENA *** y de D.a *** ELISA [VILLADEMOROS] (HOY FINADA) ***, orientales. *** ABUELOS PATERNOS D. AVELINO y D.a AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***, maternos D. PEDRO y D.a ANGELICA MENDEZ. Padrinos D. HERMENEGILDO FUENTES y D.a MERCEDES MENDEZ.' *** TWO THINGS THE INDEX GOT WRONG AND THE PLATE GOT RIGHT: *** it reads the father as 'Alejandro M. SERENA' - the S-for-L this archive has now met five times - and the grandmother as 'Ambrosia TRECIBEL'. Both are LERENA and TRAIBEL in the priest's hand. *** SHE IS IN BUENOS AIRES IN 1918, WITH A HUSBAND AND A DAUGHTER, 10 October 2026. *** The Basilica San Jose de Flores baptised *** BEATRIZ ELIZA DEL CORAZON DE JESUS *** on 20 January 1918, born *** 17 November 1917 ***: '*** hija legitima de D. EUGENIO MARCOS ABELLA, natural de URUGUAY, de cuarenta y un anos, y de Dona JACINTA LERENA VILLADEMOROS, natural de URUGUAY, de treinta y seis anos, domiciliados en MEMBRILLAR 96 ***'. *** SO THE VILLADEMOROS BRANCH CROSSED TO BUENOS AIRES *** - a Montevideo family in a Flores parish of the Argentine capital, which is a different Flores entirely from the Uruguayan department this archive works in. *** THE AGE DOES NOT AGREE WITH THIS ROW AND IS RECORDED AS A CONFLICT: *** she is given as thirty-six in January 1918, which is a birth about *** 1881 ***, where this row carries *** 19 September 1876 *** from her baptism - she would be forty-one. *** A STATED AGE ON A BAPTISM ACT IS THE PARENT'S OWN ACCOUNT AND IS OFTEN SHORT ***, and this archive does not change a baptismal date on the strength of one. *** THE IDENTIFICATION RESTS ON THE COMPOUND SURNAME, WHICH IS RARE, AND ON URUGUAYAN BIRTH. ***

name: Fernando MORATORIO (the younger)
source: Catedral Basilica de Montevideo - the two baptisms of 8 March 1880, folios 411-412 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713378 image 02598; and Uruguay, Civil Registration - Montevideo, 4a seccion, MARRIAGE act No. 83 of 20 November 1897, folio 42, expediente No. 94 - *** PLATE READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N35B-M; index ark 1:1:XS6K-MYFD; volume 'Montevideo. note: *** HE WAS MISSING FROM THIS REGISTER WHILE HIS PARENTS, HIS WIFE AND BOTH HIS DAUGHTERS WERE IN IT. *** Entered 28 September 2026, found by asking which people the register NAMES but does not HOLD. Husband of *** JOSEFA LERENA TRAIBEL (1851-1947) ***, Avelino and Ambrosia's daughter, and father of *** MARIA CARLOTA and MARIA DE LAS MERCEDES MORATORIO LERENA ***, baptised together at the Catedral Basilica on 8 March 1880 - the twins settled on the plate, both acts reading 'que nacio el veinte y cuatro de Febrero ultimo'. His own parents are named on those same acts as the paternal grandparents: *** FERNANDO MORATORIO the elder and NICOLASA TORRES ***. *** HE IS THE JOINT THE WHOLE MORATORIO BRANCH HANGS FROM ***, and for six months it hung from nothing. *** HE WITNESSED HIS NIECE-BY-MARRIAGE'S WEDDING, 20 November 1897 - found 11 October 2026. *** The act names *** 'Don FERNANDO MORATORIO, de CINCUENTA anos de edad, de estado casado, de profesion COMERCIO, de nacionalidad ORIENTAL, domiciliado en la calle URUGUAY No. 97' *** as the first witness at the marriage of *** ANGELICA MARIA LERENA VILLADEMOROS ***, who is the daughter of his wife's brother. *** FIFTY IN 1897 GIVES HIM A BIRTH YEAR OF ABOUT 1847 ***, which fits a man married to Josefa Lerena Traibel, born 1851. *** THE IDENTIFICATION IS ON AGE, PLACE, STATUS AND THE FAMILY TIE, NOT ON THE NAME ALONE *** - his father of the same name is a generation older - but it is not proved, and the act does not name his wife. *** HE IS ALSO THE REASON THE MORATORIO SURNAME RECURS IN THIS REGISTER ***: the Moratorio Lerena children are his.

Serapio Fernandez 1885)' - and a second today from the birth act that named her parents. *** Merged 9 October 2026, and the duplicate was caught by tools/check-duplicates.py rather than noticed *** - which is the gate doing in one build what this archive once took three weeks to do by hand. *** 26 JUNE 1885: dispensed the SECOND GRADE of consanguinity by the EQUAL lateral line to marry DON SERAPIO FERNANDEZ (hijo). *** *** EQUAL SECOND DEGREE IS FIRST COUSINS *** - she and her husband shared a grandparent. *** AND THE GROOM IS A FERNANDEZ ***, which is the surname of Sancho Llerena's wife Maria Fernandez and of Avelino Lerena Fernandez. *** A CONSANGUINITY DISPENSATION IS A STATEMENT ABOUT ANCESTRY. *** The Church computed the degree before it would dispense, so the entry constrains a pedigree even though it names no parent. *** The register itself names NO PARENTS *** - it is the Vicar General's summary ledger, not the expediente. *** NO BIRTH YEAR IS RECORDED HERE, and one was briefly invented. *** This row first carried a year reached by assuming an ordinary age at marriage. *** That is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact ***, it is what this archive did to William John Taylor on 8 October, and tools/check-duplicates.py caught it the same way - by matching the invented year against real namesakes. *** The dispensation register gives no age and no birth. *** *** AND HER WEDDING DAY MAY NOW BE KNOWN: 15 JULY 1885 ***, three weeks after the dispensation of 26 June. note: *** A LERENA WHO MARRIED A PELAEZ A GENERATION BEFORE THE OTHERS. *** On 6 March 1880 at Trinidad, *** MARIA PELAEZ, thirty, 'hija legitima de Don JUAN PELAEZ [y] de Dona ANTONINA LERENA' ***, married Don Rafael Sanchez, a widower - and *** Antonina witnessed her own daughter's wedding ***, with Don Balbino Pelaez. *** A DAUGHTER OF THIRTY IN 1880 PUTS HER OWN BIRTH NEAR 1830. *** *** SO A LERENA MARRIED A PELAEZ AROUND 1845 ***, and Bernabe Lerena married another Pelaez a generation later. *** That is why the couples of 1885, 1894 and 1913 all needed dispensing: two families had been marrying each other for two generations. *** *** HER PARENTS, 9 October 2026, AND SHE IS DRAWN AS A DAUGHTER. *** The kinship schema on the 1858 Bernabe Lerena expediente puts *** RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ *** at the apex and runs a line down to *** ANTONINA LERENA / JUAN PELAES ***, *** so she is a daughter of Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez and a SISTER OF ALEJANDRO LERENA. *** *** NATURAL DE SAN JOSE ***, by the same document. *** AND SHE IS THE MOTHER OF CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***, who married Alejandro's son Bernabe - which is the whole of the second degree the Archbishop dispensed in 1858. *** THE TRANSCRIPT WRITES HER 'ANTONINA LORENA' IN THE DIAGRAM AND 'ANTONINA LERENA' FOUR LINES ABOVE IT, IN THE SAME HAND. *** *** HER DEATH ACT, READ OFF THE PLATE 10 October 2026 - AND IT CONFIRMS THE 1858 DIAGRAM FROM A CIVIL REGISTER. *** She died at *** Cerro Colorado, Sexta Seccion de Flores, on 22 July 1911 ***, on her own estancia, registered on the 28th: '*** ANTONINA ISABEL LERENA DE PELAEZ... NACIDA EN MONTEVIDEO, de NOVENTA Y DOS ANOS de edad, de estado viuda... hija legitima de Don RAMON LERENA y de Dona MARIA GONZALEZ, fallecidos ***'. *** A PRIEST DREW THAT PARENTAGE IN 1858 AND A JUEZ DE PAZ WROTE IT IN 1911, IN TWO SEPARATE RECORD SYSTEMS. *** *** HER AGE CORRECTS THIS ROW: *** it carried 1830, inferred from a daughter of thirty in 1880; the act states ninety-two, so *** about 1819 ***. *** AND HER BIRTHPLACE CONTRADICTS THE 1858 EXPEDIENTE ***, which calls her and Juan Pelaez 'naturales de SAN JOSE'. *** SHE WAS BORN AT MONTEVIDEO ***, which is where Ramon's other children were christened between 1812 and 1821. Recorded as a conflict. *** HER HUSBAND IS JUAN PEDRO PELAEZ ***, not simply Juan. *** AND SHE LEFT FOUR CHILDREN, NAMED: CASIMIRA JOSEFA, MALBINO HIPOLITO, MARIA INOCENCIA and JUAN FABIAN *** - three of whom this register already held as separate people. *** A SON, ALEJANDRO PABLO, BORN 30 JUNE 1856 AT TRINIDAD, 25 October 2026 ***, 'hijo legitimo de Juan Pedro Pelar [Pelaez] y Antonina Perena [Lerena]; padrinos Alejandro Teresa [Lerena?] y Margarita Fernandez Alvarez' - Margarita's husband is Alejandro, so the godparents are the child's uncle and aunt. *** NAMED AS THE GRANDMOTHER OF LAUREANA PELAEZ, 25 JUNE 1878, 29 October 2026, *** and on 14 June 1879 (image 226) as the maternal grandmother of Eduviges Lerena - the mother of Casimira Pelaez, Bernabe's wife. (Machine transcripts.)

note: *** THE FATHER OF THE TRINIDAD KINDRED, found 9 October 2026 in two expedientes three years apart. *** Named in 1855 as the father of *** SOCORRO LERENA *** and in 1858 as the father of *** BERNABE LERENA ***, both times married to *** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ [ALVAREZ] ***, and in 1854 as the father of *** ALEJANDRO LERENA the younger ***. *** THREE CHILDREN, FROM THREE SEPARATE DOCUMENTS. *** *** NATURAL DE SAN JOSE, VECINO DE TRINIDAD *** - the 1858 expediente says so of him and his wife. *** ALIVE IN AUGUST 1855 ***, when his daughter's petition describes her living at her parents' side. *** HIS OWN PARENTS ARE DRAWN ABOVE HIM: RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ ***, at the apex of the schema the Cura Vicario drew in 1858. *** NO BIRTH YEAR IS RECORDED AND NONE IS INVENTED HERE. *** His daughter was born about 1832, so he belongs to the 1800s or the 1790s.  *** HIS OWN MARRIAGE ACT, READ OFF THE PLATE THE SAME DAY HE WAS ADDED. *** Act No. 17, *** 16 September 1825 ***, Villa y Parroquia de San Jose, before Don Joseph Andres Salvatierra: '*** ALEXANDRO LEREÑA, Natural de la VILLA DEL ROSARIO, y vecino de esta, hijo legitimo de RAMON LEREÑA y de MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ ***'. *** SO HE IS A SON OF RAMON LERENA OF ROSARIO-COLLA AND A BROTHER OF MAURICIO ***, a descent this archive has held in data/ramon-lerena-rosario.tsv since 17 September. *** AND HIS BIRTHPLACE CONTRADICTS THE 1858 EXPEDIENTE, WHICH CALLS HIM AND MARGARITA 'NATURALES DE SAN JOSE'. *** *** THE 1825 ACT IS THE BETTER WITNESS *** - it is his own marriage, and it says ROSARIO, while calling Margarita *** natural de esta Villa ***, which IS San Jose. *** THE EXPEDIENTE'S PLURAL LOOKS LIKE A CLERK COLLAPSING TWO ORIGINS INTO ONE. *** Recorded as a conflict, not resolved by preference. *** A FOURTH CHILD, PROBABLY: ESTEFANIA, 17 October 2026. *** The 1872 christening of her daughter Cesarea at San Jose names 'Dn. Alejandro y Da. Margarita Fernandez' as the mother's parents, and the mother is Estefania Lerena, wife of Servando Gonzalez. This row's three children - Socorro, Alejandro the younger and Bernabe - came from the dispensation expedientes, which draw only the lines they need to prove an impediment, so a daughter missing from them is not evidence that she did not exist. Identified on surname, forenames, Fernandez and birthplace, AND NAMED IN A SECOND ACT - the Trinidad baptism of 1867 of Estefania's daughter Estefania Fausta Leopoldina, 'Maternos Alejandro y Margarita Fernandez'; [SUPERSEDED 18 October 2026: ESTEFANIA'S OWN BAPTISM NAMES HIM AS HER FATHER - see below.] *** HIS PARENTS ARE NAMED IN A SECOND DOCUMENT, 17 October 2026: *** the San Jose christening of 7 March 1829 of his son Alexandro Florencio calls him 'Alexandro Llerena' and gives HIS parents as 'Ramon y Maria Gonzalez' - the apex of the 1858 diagram - and Socorro's civil death act of 1921 repeats it ('Abuelos paternos: Ramon Lerena y Maria ...'). *** A GODMOTHER 'CLARA LLERENA' STOOD AT THE FONT IN 1829, *** perhaps a sister of his; nothing in the act says how she was related. THIS ROW'S CHILDREN ARE NOW FIVE, NOT THREE: Maria (b. about 1827-28), Alejandro (b. 23 February 1829), Estefania (probably), Socorro and Bernabe. *** TWO MORE BAPTISMS OF HIS DAUGHTERS, READ AT THE PLATE, 18 October 2026: *** Ana Estefania (born about 7 January 1831, act 149 at San Jose) and Maria del Socorro (born late September 1832, act 499 at San Jose) - each names 'Alejandro Lerena' and Margarita Fernandez as her parents, and Socorro's gives HIS parents as Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez. *** THE SIBSHIP IS NOW FIVE, EACH DOCUMENTED BY A BAPTISM (Maria Casilda's identified with the Maria of her 1892 death act on the parents' names): *** Maria Casilda (baptised 11 April 1827), Alejandro (23 February 1829), Estefania (about 7 January 1831), Socorro (late September 1832) and Bernabe (10 June 1836, found and read the same day). The spacing is about two years until Bernabe, who follows Socorro by nearly four. There are no twins. *** HIS SON BERNABE'S BAPTISM, 18 October 2026, NAMES HIM AGAIN AS 'D.n Alejandro Lerena' and gives BOTH grandparent lines: *** Ramon and Maria Gonzalez, and Juan and Barbara Sotura (his wife's parents). All five children are now documented by their own baptism or death act. *** HIS ELDEST, MARIA CASILDA, BAPTISED AT SAN JOSE IN APRIL 1827, 18 October 2026: *** he is 'Alexandro Lerena' and gives HIS parents as 'Ramon y Maria de Leon' (the 1829 and 1832 acts have Maria Gonzalez; the 1812 act of his brother has Maria Josefa Gonzalez, daughter of Marcial de Leon Gonzalez) - so Maria Gonzalez and Maria de Leon are almost certainly one woman, 'Maria [Josefa] [de Leon] Gonzalez' - the 1812 and 1816 acts write her both ways. The godparents are Marcos de Leon Gonzalez - his mother's kin - and Maria Fernandez Albarez, his wife's sister. *** MORE CHILDREN FROM THE SAN JOSE BAPTISMS OF 1838-1840, 19 October 2026: *** Ramon Inocencio, born 28 July 1838 (a row of his own), and the kinship of a sister, Isabel Lerena, whose daughter Juana Antonia was baptised on 11 May 1840 with 'Alejandro Lorena y Margarita Fernandez' as godparents. With Maria Casilda (1827), Alejandro (1829), Estefania (1831), Socorro (1832), Natalia (15 May 1834), Bernabe (1836) and Ramon Inocencio (1838), that is seven of the nine children the petition of 1853 counts. *** AT TRINIDAD BY APRIL 1843, 19 October 2026: *** on 10 April 1843 'Alejandro Herena y Marqa Fernandez' [Lerena and Maria/Margarita] stand godparents at Trinidad (Laurencia Vicenta, born 5 April, child of Feliciano Salas and Martiniana Ojeda of Minas); in March 1844 a child 'Eugenio', born 26 February, is baptised as the child of 'Alejandro Herena y Margarita Fernandez de S. Jose y vecinos de este Pueblo' with 'Mariquita Elerena' as godmother - perhaps their eldest daughter Maria, seventeen - and is buried on 3 March, a few days old; and on 18 June 1847 'Don Alejandro Lerena y Dona Margarita Fernandez' are godparents of Margarita Antonia, a daughter of Manuel Fernandez and Maria de los Reyes Gonzalez. Eugenio (1844) lived days and is not among the nine of 1853, so two of those nine are still not found. *** A CHILD BAPTISED AT SAN JOSE ON 27 JUNE 1845, 26 October 2026: *** Isaac Filomeno, born 3 June 1845, 'hijo legitimo de Don Alejandro Llerena, y de Dona Margarita Fernandez Alvarez' - the father is written with his own name and the mother with the compound surname, so the entry is theirs. It is the baptism a year and a quarter after Eugenio's burial at Trinidad, and it is in San Jose, not Trinidad, where the enslaved Barbara was held in April 1846. *** NO CHILD OF HIS BORN BEFORE MARIA CASILDA, 26 October 2026: *** the San Jose baptism volume of July 1822 - April 1828 (images 55-126, from May 1824 to April 1828) holds only Maria Casilda (11 April 1827, image 103) for him and Margarita, so no child of 1826 was baptised there, in the year after the marriage of September 1825. *** A WITNESS AT HIS DAUGHTER ESTEFANIA'S MARRIAGE, 13 July 1853, 26 October 2026: *** at Trinidad, with Margarita Fernandez, 'padres de la contrayente' - both were living there that July. *** A WITNESS AGAIN, AT NATALIA'S MARRIAGE ON 5 August 1861, 26 October 2026, with Margarita Fernandez *** at Trinidad - so both were living there in August 1861, eight years after the marriage of Estefania. *** A SON VITALINO, 26 October 2026: *** the death act of 1898 of his grandson Alejandro J. Lerena gives 'abuelos paternos Alejandro Lerena y Margarita Fernandez' for the son of Vitalino Lerena and Andrea Etcheverse - the ninth child of the couple, and the last of the nine of 1853. *** HIS BURIAL, 2 APRIL 1874, READ AT THE PLATE, 26 October 2026: *** no. 40, 'Alejandro Lerena', buried at Trinidad with the cross and the offices of the first class: 'al cadaver de Dn. Alejandro Lerena, oriental, de sesenta y cinco anos de edad, viudo de la finada Da. Margarita Fernandez. Murio ayer de un ataque y recibio la Extremaunccion'. *** SO HE DIED ON 1 APRIL 1874, A WIDOWER, FIVE YEARS AFTER HIS WIFE. *** The age sixty-five would put his birth about 1809 and make him sixteen at the marriage of September 1825 - a clerk's round figure for an old man, not a date this row relies on; the act is read for the widowhood and the year of death. *** CONFIRMED BY A CIVIL ACT OF 20 APRIL 1902, 27 October 2026: *** the death act of his grandson Gualberto, 20 April 1902, names him and 'dona Margarita Fernandez Alvarez' as Gualberto's paternal grandparents, 'fallecidos' - a civil act of 1902 agreeing with the plate of his burial of 1874. (Machine transcript.) *** 'EL FINADO JOSE ALEJANDRO LERENA', 14 JUNE 1879, 29 October 2026: *** named with the word 'finado' as the paternal grandfather of Eduviges, daughter of Bernabe Lerena and Casimira Pelaez, beside 'Dona Margarita Fernandez' (no marker for her) - consistent with the death of 1 April 1874 held on this row. note: *** THE MOTHER OF THE TRINIDAD KINDRED, and the reason its first two marriages needed dispensing. *** Named in the expedientes of 1855, 1854 and 1858 as the wife of Alejandro Lerena and the mother of *** SOCORRO ***, *** ALEJANDRO the younger *** and *** BERNABE ***. The 1854 document gives her compound surname in full: *** FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***. *** THAT IS WHY SOCORRO MARRIED A FERNANDEZ IN THE SECOND DEGREE: *** her husband's father is *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***, so Margarita and Manuel are almost certainly brother and sister - *** which is what a second grade in the transverse line requires, and it is an inference from the degree and the compound surname, not a statement in either act. *** *** NATURAL DE SAN JOSE ***, resident at Trinidad, alive in August 1855.  *** HER PARENTS, AND THEY TURN AN INFERENCE INTO A DOCUMENT. *** The act of 16 September 1825 calls her '*** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ, Natural de esta Villa, hija legitima de JUAN FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ y de BARBARA SOTURA ***'. *** THIS ROW GUESSED THIS MORNING THAT SHE AND MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ WERE BROTHER AND SISTER *** and said so was 'required by the degree and not written down in either act'. *** IT IS WRITTEN DOWN NOW, IN A THIRD ACT: *** the 1855 expediente gives Serapio Fernandez's grandparents as *** 'Don JUAN y Dona BARBARA SOTURA' ***, and those are her parents. *** SO MANUEL IS HER BROTHER, AND SOCORRO AND SERAPIO ARE FIRST COUSINS BY A DOCUMENTED PATH *** - exactly the second grade dispensed in 1855. *** AND HER SISTER MARIA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ WAS GODMOTHER AT HER WEDDING. *** *** A FOURTH CHILD: ESTEFANIA, 17 October 2026 [CONFIRMED 18 October 2026 BY HER OWN BAPTISM, BELOW]. *** Estefania Lerena's daughter Cesarea was christened at San Jose in 1872 with 'Dn. source: Valparaiso, Chile. note: *** THE SECOND OF THE FOUR UNTRACED FATHERS OF CAJON 985, AND THE ONE THIS ARCHIVE HAD ALREADY GOT WRONG. *** The Chilean death registration of his infant son, 18 September 1894, names him '*** padre ARTURO LERENA GARCIA ***' - *** SO HIS MOTHER WAS A GARCIA ***, which is the first thing ever held about his parents. *** AND IT CONFIRMS A WITHDRAWAL: *** data/cajon-985-origins.tsv first read him as a son of AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL and withdrew it the same day as a conflation with *** JUAN ARTURO LERENA TRAIBEL *** (wife Ema Regules). *** A MAN WRITTEN LERENA GARCIA IS NOT A SON OF AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***, so the doubt is now a document. *** HIS FAMILY MOVED ACROSS THE ANDES AND BACK: *** La Pampa 1889, *** VALPARAISO 1893-94 ***, Mendoza 1896, Entre Rios 1897 - and Mendoza is the Argentine city at the foot of the pass to Valparaiso. *** HE IS NOT PLACED IN A COUNTRY. *** The Chilean form records nationality for the DECEASED only and never asks where the father was born. *** THE TEST: *** his marriage to Amalia Diaz, or an Entre Rios civil registration of one of his other children. *** HE IS SPANISH AND HE IS A JOURNALIST, 10 October 2026 - AND THAT BREAKS A PATTERN THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHED THE DAY BEFORE. *** His son Antonio's marriage at Crespo, Entre Rios, on 24 October 1924 is a printed form with a 'de nacionalidad' blank for each parent, and it reads '*** hijo de ARTURO LERENA, de nacionalidad ESPANOLA, de profesion PERIODISTA, y de AMALIA DIAZ, de nacionalidad PERUANA ***'. *** HE ALSO STOOD WITNESS AT THAT WEDDING: *** 'Los testigos *** Arturo Lerena, de cincuenta y [units digit not read] anos, de profesion Periodista, de estado casado, domiciliado en PARANA ***' - *** so born about 1865-1874 ***, and the age is what proves the witness is the father and not the son, who was twenty-eight. *** SO THE CLAIM THAT EVERY TRACEABLE FATHER IN CAJON 985 IS URUGUAYAN OR MARRIED IN URUGUAY IS BROKEN *** - he is a Spaniard married to a Peruvian. *** WHAT SURVIVES IS WEAKER: NOT ONE OF THE FIVE IS ARGENTINE. *** See data/corrections.tsv. *** AND HIS MOTHER WAS A GARCIA *** by the Chilean compound - so a Spanish-born Lerena whose mother's surname is known, which is what /open-questions/ question 5 has been asking for. *** A THIRD POSSIBLE SON, 11 October 2026: *** *** VICENTE LERENA DIAZ ***, Jefe del Registro Civil of Pueblo Brugo in Entre Rios in 1938 - the department where Antonio married in 1924. *** NOT ESTABLISHED. *** *** IF IT HOLDS, THIS SPANISH JOURNALIST'S SONS PUT DOWN ROOTS IN ONE ARGENTINE DEPARTMENT ***, which is a shape this archive could test against the Entre Rios registers rather than guess at.

name: Manuel LERENA (son of Mauricio, m. Jacinta Marina 1882)
source: FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the Trinidad, Flores birthplace sweep, pages 1-4, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***; and FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the MANUEL LERENA sweep, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***
note: *** A SON OF MAURICIO LERENA AND CASIMIRA MONTANO, found 11 October 2026 - and he matters because of WHOSE son he is. *** Born about *** 1856 ***, he married *** JACINTA MARINA *** at *** Santisima Trinidad in April 1882 ***. His parents are given on the act as *** MAURICIO LERENA and CASIMIRA MONTANA ***. *** THAT IS THE COLLA-ROSARIO COUPLE MARRIED IN 1837 *** - so a child of the Rosario house was living, and marrying, at *** TRINIDAD in FLORES *** by 1882. *** THIS IS A SECOND THREAD BETWEEN THE ROSARIO-COLLA HOUSE AND THE TRINIDAD KINDRED ***, alongside the bridge already held in data/colla-trinidad-bridge.tsv, and it is independent of it. *** INDEX ONLY; the act has not been opened and his birthplace is the index's word, not a record's. *** *** THE CIVIL REGISTRATION OF THE SAME MARRIAGE IS FOUND, 11 October 2026, AND IT CONFIRMS HIS PARENTS OUTRIGHT. *** The index carries him as *** 'MANUEL LERENA MONTANA' ***, born *** 1856 ***, married *** 1 APRIL 1882 *** and registered *** 20 April 1882 ***, 'hijo de *** MAURICIO LERENA *** y *** CASIMIRA MONTANA ***', to *** JACINTA MERINA SANTOS ***. *** THE COMPOUND SURNAME LERENA MONTANA IS THE PROOF *** - it carries his mother's name and it is not something an indexer invents. *** BUT THE TWO RECORDS DISAGREE ABOUT WHERE. *** The parish act is at *** SANTISIMA TRINIDAD, FLORES ***; the civil registration is at *** SAN JOSE ***. Those are different departments. *** RECORDED AS A CONFLICT AND NOT RESOLVED *** - a civil registration can be filed where a party resided rather than where the ceremony was, and neither act has been opened. *** AND HE HAS A FULLER NAME AND A SON: *** his son's 1910 marriage registration at Florida gives the father as *** 'MANUEL DOROTEO' *** and the mother as *** 'JACINTA' ***, so he is *** MANUEL DOROTEO LERENA *** and the boy is *** MANUEL VICENTE LERENA MARINO ***.

name: Manuel LERENA Leonard (m. Juana Galarza 1890)

note: *** HE ANSWERS HALF OF WORK-LIST ROW 187, found 11 October 2026. *** Born about *** 1866 ***, son of *** PEDRO ANTONIO LERENA *** and *** TERESA LEONARD ***, he married *** JUANA GALARZA *** on *** 19 FEBRUARY 1890 *** at *** Nuestra Senora del Carmen La Mayor, CORDON, Montevideo ***, and died at Montevideo on *** 1 APRIL 1926 ***, registered the next day. *** WHY THIS MATTERS TO ROW 187: *** that row holds a findmypast household of *** 'MANUEL x JUANA FERREIROZ', Montevideo 1891 *** - a child baptised the year after this wedding, to a Manuel and a Juana, in the same city. *** THE TWO ARE PROBABLY ONE COUPLE AND 'FERREIROZ' IS PROBABLY A MISREADING OF GALARZA ***, which is the kind of error this archive has catalogued many times. *** NOT MERGED: *** the surnames are not close enough to assert it, the findmypast transcript has not been re-read, and neither act has been opened. *** THE TEST IS CHEAP: open the 1891 baptism and read the mother's surname. *** *** THAT HYPOTHESIS WAS WEAKENED WITHIN THE HOUR AND IS WITHDRAWN AS STATED. *** A search on the forename FELICIA turned up the 1891 child herself - *** FELICIA LERENA, born 6 May 1891 and christened 16 May 1891 at Montevideo *** - in *** TWO SEPARATE COLLECTIONS ***, the civil register and the parish baptisms, and *** BOTH NAME THE MOTHER 'JUANA FERREIROZ' ***. One index mangling a surname is ordinary; two independent records agreeing on it is evidence that the surname IS Ferreiroz. *** SO MANUEL x JUANA FERREIROZ IS PROBABLY A DIFFERENT COUPLE FROM MANUEL LERENA LEONARD x JUANA GALARZA ***, and the resemblance was only the forename Juana and the city. *** THE TEST IS UNCHANGED AND NOW MATTERS MORE: open the 1891 baptism. *** *** HE DECLARED HIS MOTHER'S DEATH, 17 October 2026: *** her civil act no. 252 of 27 August 1901 has 'Manuel Lerena, casado, de nacionalidad oriental, militar, vecino de la 8a Seccion', about thirty-eight, as the first declarant, and says she left 'un hijo llamado Manuel'. THAT IS A SOLDIER OF ABOUT 38 IN 1901, so born about 1863, where this row has 1866 - the row's year is unchecked and the act is the nearer source.
